questions.stem: In the sentence "What matters most is not how much you have, but how much you give.", the subject of the sentence is _______.
opts: "What matters most"
"how much you have"
"how much you give"
"not how much you have, but how much you give"
questions.explain: "What matters most" 是主语从句，充当整个句子的主语；系动词 is 之后是表语部分。

questions.stem: The sentence "So absorbed was she in her book that she didn't notice the time." is an example of _______.
opts: partial inversion caused by "so...that" structure
full inversion caused by adverbial fronting
emphatic "it" pattern
subjunctive conditional clause
questions.explain: "So + adj." 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，即 "So absorbed was she..."，属于 so...that 结构引起的倒装。

questions.stem: In "The professor, together with his assistants, ________ conducting the experiment.", the correct verb form is _______.
opts: are
is
were
have been
questions.explain: 主语为 The professor，后接 together with 等短语时，谓语动词仍与真正主语保持一致，故用单数 is。

questions.stem: In the sentence "It is essential that every student ________ the safety rules.", the correct fill is _______.
opts: follows
follow
followed
is following
questions.explain: 在 It is essential that... 结构中，that 从句需用虚拟语气，谓语动词用 (should) + 动词原形，故填 follow。

questions.stem: The phrase "the book which I borrowed from the library yesterday" contains a(n) _______.
opts: restrictive attributive clause
non-restrictive attributive clause
appositive clause
object clause
questions.explain: 限制性定语从句（restrictive attributive clause）无逗号分隔，对先行词起限定作用，去掉后句意不完整。

questions.stem: In "Had it not been for your help, I would have failed.", the underlined part expresses _______.
opts: real condition
unreal past condition
concession
purpose
questions.explain: "Had it not been for..." 是虚拟语气中表示与过去事实相反的 if 条件句的倒装形式，相当于 "If it had not been for..."。

questions.stem: In the sentence "The fact that he succeeded surprised everyone.", the clause "that he succeeded" functions as a(n) _______.
opts: attributive clause
appositive clause
subject clause
predicative clause
questions.explain: that he succeeded 解释说明 The fact 的具体内容，且 that 在从句中不充当任何成分，故为同位语从句（appositive clause）。

questions.stem: The sentence "Never before ________ such a moving speech." requires the correct order: _______.
opts: I have heard
have I heard
I heard
did I heard
questions.explain: Never before 为否定副词置于句首，主句需部分倒装，助动词 have 提前，构成 "have I heard"。

questions.stem: The fact that he failed the exam surprised his parents, who had always believed he was a diligent student. 这句话中，"that he failed the exam" 在句中充当什么成分？
opts: 主语从句
同位语从句
定语从句
宾语从句
questions.explain: that引导的从句放在抽象名词fact之后，解释fact的具体内容，是同位语从句。

questions.stem: The book, which was published last year, has become a bestseller. 这句话中，"which was published last year" 是什么从句？
opts: 限制性定语从句
非限制性定语从句
同位语从句
状语从句
questions.explain: which引导的从句用逗号与主句隔开，对先行词book进行补充说明，是非限制性定语从句。

questions.stem: Only when we understand the importance of environmental protection can we take effective measures. 这句话使用了什么语法结构？
opts: 倒装结构
强调结构
虚拟语气
被动语态
questions.explain: "Only + 状语从句"置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，即情态动词can提前到主语we之前。

questions.stem: What he said at the meeting made everyone present think deeply. 这句话中，"What he said at the meeting" 在句中充当什么成分？
opts: 主语
宾语
表语
定语
questions.explain: what引导的名词性从句"What he said at the meeting"在整个句子中作主语，是主语从句。

questions.stem: He is the man whom I believe can help us solve the problem. 这句话中，"whom" 在从句中充当什么成分？
opts: 宾语
主语
表语
定语
questions.explain: 虽然whom是宾格形式，但在此句中它作从句"can help us solve the problem"的主语，正确用法应为who，但口语中常见whom。

questions.stem: So difficult was the exam that few students passed it. 这句话使用了什么语法结构？
opts: 倒装结构
强调结构
比较结构
虚拟语气
questions.explain: "So + 形容词"置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，即系动词was提前到主语the exam之前，构成"so...that..."倒装句。

questions.stem: The reason why he was late is that he got stuck in a traffic jam. 这句话中，"why he was late" 是什么从句？
opts: 定语从句
同位语从句
主语从句
表语从句
questions.explain: why引导的从句修饰先行词reason，说明原因的具体内容，是定语从句。

questions.stem: It is essential that every student (should) obey the school rules. 这句话中，that从句使用了什么语气？
opts: 陈述语气
虚拟语气
祈使语气
疑问语气
questions.explain: 在"It is essential that..."句型中，that从句需用虚拟语气，即动词原形(should + 动词原形或直接动词原形)。

questions.stem: Not until the teacher came in did the students stop talking. 这句话中，主句使用了什么语法现象？
opts: 完全倒装
部分倒装
强调结构
省略结构
questions.explain: "Not until + 时间状语从句"置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，即助动词did提前到主语the students之前。

questions.stem: The man standing over there is our new manager. 这句话中，"standing over there" 在句中充当什么成分？
opts: 定语
状语
补语
表语
questions.explain: 现在分词短语"standing over there"修饰名词The man，作后置定语，相当于定语从句"who is standing over there"。

questions.stem: In the sentence "The idea that the government should regulate the economy, which was proposed by the economist, has been widely accepted", the clause "that the government should regulate the economy" serves as a(n) _______.
opts: attributive clause
appositive clause
subject clause
object clause
questions.explain: 考点：同位语从句与定语从句的区分。"that the government should regulate the economy" 是对 "The idea" 内容的解释说明，而非修饰限定，因此是同位语从句。

questions.stem: In "Not until the 19th century did scientists realize that the earth was round", the inverted structure is used because _______.
opts: the sentence begins with a negative adverbial
the subject is too long
the verb is in past tense
the sentence is a question
questions.explain: 考点：否定副词置于句首引起的部分倒装。"Not until..." 是否定结构，置于句首时主句需部分倒装（助动词提前）。

questions.stem: The sentence "It is essential that every student ______ the assignment before Friday" requires the blank to be filled with _______.
opts: finishes
finish
finished
would finish
questions.explain: 考点：虚拟语气在主语从句中的应用。在 "It is essential/necessary/important that..." 结构中，that从句应使用虚拟语气，即动词原形（should + 动词原形，should可省略）。

questions.stem: In "The professor, along with his assistants, ______ conducting the experiment", the correct verb form is _______.
opts: are
is
were
have been
questions.explain: 考点：主谓一致中的就远原则。主语是 "The professor"（单数），"along with his assistants" 是插入语，不影响主语单复数，谓语动词用单数。

questions.stem: The phrase "the more...the more..." structure in "The more you practice, the better you will become" expresses a _______.
opts: cause-and-effect relationship
proportional relationship
conditional relationship
contrastive relationship
questions.explain: 考点："the more...the more..." 比较结构。该结构表示两个事物按相同比例变化，即"越……越……"，属于比例关系（proportional relationship）。

questions.stem: In "He is known for his ability to solve problems that others find impossible", the infinitive phrase "to solve problems that others find impossible" functions as a(n) _______.
opts: object
attribute
adverbial
predicative
questions.explain: 考点：不定式作后置定语。"to solve problems that others find impossible" 修饰名词 "ability"，说明是什么样的能力，作后置定语。

questions.stem: Which of the following sentences uses a non-restrictive attributive clause correctly?
opts: The man who is standing there is my brother.
The book, which I borrowed from the library, is very interesting.
The students who study hard will pass the exam.
The house that was built last year has been sold.
questions.explain: 考点：非限制性定语从句的用法。非限制性定语从句用逗号与主句隔开，对先行词进行补充说明，关系代词用which（指物）或who（指人）。选项B符合此规则。

questions.stem: In "Were I you, I would not make such a decision", the grammatical structure is _______.
opts: subjunctive mood with inversion
conditional sentence with "if" omitted
past tense for politeness
passive voice
questions.explain: 考点：虚拟条件句的倒装。在虚拟语气中，若省略if，需将were/had/should提至主语前形成倒装。"Were I you" 相当于 "If I were you"。

questions.stem: The sentence "She insisted that the report ______ immediately" requires the blank to be filled with _______.
opts: is submitted
be submitted
was submitted
has been submitted
questions.explain: 考点：insist后接that从句的虚拟语气。当insist表示"坚持要求"时，that从句用虚拟语气（should + 动词原形，should可省略），故填"be submitted"。

questions.stem: The fact that she was able to complete the project on time, despite the limited resources, surprised everyone. 这句话中 "that she was able to complete the project on time" 在句中充当什么成分？
opts: 主语从句
同位语从句
定语从句
表语从句
questions.explain: that引导的从句紧跟在抽象名词fact之后，对fact的内容进行具体说明，因此是同位语从句。

questions.stem: The book, which was written by a famous historian, provides a detailed analysis of the economic changes that took place in the 19th century. 句中 "which was written by a famous historian" 是什么从句？
opts: 限制性定语从句
非限制性定语从句
状语从句
同位语从句
questions.explain: which引导的从句用逗号与主句隔开，对先行词book进行补充说明，是非限制性定语从句。

questions.stem: What surprised me most was that he had never been abroad before. 句中 "What surprised me most" 在句中充当什么成分？
opts: 主语从句
宾语从句
表语从句
定语从句
questions.explain: What引导的从句位于句首作主语，整个从句是主语从句。

questions.stem: I don't know whether he will come to the party or not. 句中 "whether he will come to the party or not" 充当什么成分？
opts: 主语从句
宾语从句
表语从句
同位语从句
questions.explain: whether引导的从句位于及物动词know之后，作动词的宾语，是宾语从句。

questions.stem: The reason why he was late is that he got stuck in traffic. 句中 "why he was late" 是什么从句？
opts: 同位语从句
定语从句
状语从句
表语从句
questions.explain: why引导的从句修饰先行词reason，说明具体的原因，是定语从句。

questions.stem: So quickly did he finish the work that everyone was amazed. 这个句子使用了什么语法结构？
opts: 倒装结构
强调结构
虚拟语气
被动语态
questions.explain: "So quickly" 位于句首引起部分倒装，助动词did提前，是倒装结构。

questions.stem: It was in this very room that the historic agreement was signed. 这个句子属于什么结构？
opts: 主语从句
强调句型
倒装句
定语从句
questions.explain: "It is/was...that..." 是典型的强调句型，此处强调地点状语 "in this very room"。

questions.stem: Were I you, I would accept the offer immediately. 句中 "Were I you" 表示什么含义？
opts: 真实条件
虚拟条件（与现在事实相反）
虚拟条件（与过去事实相反）
让步状语
questions.explain: "Were I you" 是省略if的虚拟条件句倒装形式，表示与现在事实相反的假设。

questions.stem: The experiment, the results of which were published last month, has attracted wide attention. 句中 "the results of which" 在从句中充当什么成分？
opts: 主语
宾语
定语
状语
questions.explain: "the results of which" 中which指代experiment，整个短语在定语从句中作主语。

questions.stem: Not until the teacher came in did the students stop talking. 这个句子使用了什么语法现象？
opts: 全部倒装
部分倒装
强调句型
省略结构
questions.explain: "Not until..." 位于句首时，主句需部分倒装，助动词did提前，属于部分倒装。

questions.stem: The fact that she was able to finish the project on time surprised everyone. 该句中 "that she was able to finish the project on time" 充当什么成分？
opts: 主语从句
同位语从句
定语从句
宾语从句
questions.explain: that引导的从句位于抽象名词fact之后，对fact的内容进行解释说明，是同位语从句。

questions.stem: The book, which was published last year, has become a bestseller. 该句中 "which was published last year" 是什么从句？
opts: 限制性定语从句
非限制性定语从句
同位语从句
状语从句
questions.explain: which引导的从句用逗号与主句隔开，对先行词book进行补充说明，是非限制性定语从句。

questions.stem: What he said at the meeting made everyone think. 该句中 "What he said at the meeting" 在句中充当什么成分？
opts: 主语
宾语
表语
定语
questions.explain: what引导的名词性从句位于句首作主语，是主语从句。

questions.stem: I don't know whether he will come or not. 该句中 "whether he will come or not" 充当什么成分？
opts: 主语从句
表语从句
宾语从句
同位语从句
questions.explain: whether引导的从句位于及物动词know之后，作动词的宾语，是宾语从句。

questions.stem: The reason why he was late is that his car broke down. 该句中 "why he was late" 是什么从句？
opts: 同位语从句
定语从句
主语从句
表语从句
questions.explain: why引导的从句修饰先行词reason，说明原因，是定语从句。

questions.stem: It is important that everyone should obey the rules. 该句中 "that everyone should obey the rules" 是真正的主语，这种结构称为？
opts: 强调句
形式主语结构
倒装句
省略句
questions.explain: it作形式主语，that引导的从句是真正的主语，这是形式主语结构。

questions.stem: Not until he arrived did we start the meeting. 该句使用了什么语法结构？
opts: 完全倒装
部分倒装
强调句
虚拟语气
questions.explain: Not until置于句首时，主句需用部分倒装，即助动词did提到主语we之前。

questions.stem: Had I known the truth, I would have told you. 该句使用了什么语法现象？
opts: 虚拟语气（与过去事实相反）
虚拟语气（与现在事实相反）
条件状语从句的省略与倒装
强调句
questions.explain: if条件句中若有had/were/should，可省略if并将had/were/should提到主语前，形成倒装。

questions.stem: The man standing over there is our new teacher. 该句中 "standing over there" 充当什么成分？
opts: 定语
状语
补语
主语
questions.explain: 现在分词短语standing over there修饰名词the man，作后置定语。

questions.stem: Given more time, we could have done it better. 该句中 "Given more time" 是什么成分？
opts: 定语
同位语
条件状语
原因状语
questions.explain: 过去分词短语Given more time在句中作条件状语，相当于If we had been given more time。

questions.stem: The fact that she was able to complete the project on time, despite the limited resources, surprised everyone. 该句中 "that she was able to complete the project on time" 在句中充当什么成分？
opts: 主语从句
同位语从句
定语从句
表语从句
questions.explain: 考点：同位语从句。that引导的从句跟在抽象名词fact之后，解释fact的具体内容，且从句结构完整，不缺少任何成分，故为同位语从句。

questions.stem: The book, which was written by a famous historian, provides a detailed analysis of the economic changes that took place in the 19th century. 该句的主干是？
opts: The book provides a detailed analysis of the economic changes
The book was written by a famous historian
The book provides a detailed analysis
The economic changes took place in the 19th century
questions.explain: 考点：句子主干提取。which引导的非限制性定语从句和that引导的定语从句均为修饰成分，去掉后主干为The book provides a detailed analysis of the economic changes。

questions.stem: Only after the meeting ended did he realize that he had forgotten to bring the documents. 该句使用了什么语法结构？
opts: 强调句
倒装句
虚拟语气
省略句
questions.explain: 考点：倒装结构。"Only + 状语"置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，即助动词did提到主语he之前，构成倒装句。

questions.stem: It is essential that every student ( ) the safety rules before entering the laboratory.
opts: follows
follow
must follow
followed
questions.explain: 考点：虚拟语气在主语从句中的应用。在It is essential that...结构中，that从句谓语动词用"(should)+动词原形"，should可省略，故填follow。

questions.stem: The professor, together with his assistants, ( ) conducting experiments in the lab when the power went out.
opts: were
was
have been
are
questions.explain: 考点：主谓一致。主语为The professor，后跟together with...为插入语，不影响主语单复数，谓语动词应用单数was。

questions.stem: Had it not been for your timely help, we would not have completed the task on time. 该句表达的意思是？
opts: 因为你的帮助，我们按时完成了任务
如果没有你的帮助，我们就无法按时完成任务
你的帮助来得太晚了
我们不需要你的帮助也能完成任务
questions.explain: 考点：虚拟条件句的倒装。Had it not been for...相当于If it had not been for...，表示与过去事实相反的假设，主句would not have completed暗示实际完成了任务，故表达"因为你的帮助，我们按时完成了"。

questions.stem: The reason ( ) he was late for the interview was that his car broke down on the highway.
opts: why
that
which
for which
questions.explain: 考点：定语从句关系副词。先行词为the reason，从句he was late for the interview结构完整，不缺主语或宾语，故用关系副词why引导定语从句。

questions.stem: Not until the teacher came in did the students stop talking. 对划线部分（the students stop talking）提问，应选？
opts: When did the students stop talking?
What did the students do when the teacher came in?
Why did the students stop talking?
How did the students stop talking?
questions.explain: 考点：特殊疑问句与倒装。原句为倒装结构，提问"学生做了什么"应用What did the students do when the teacher came in?，保持疑问语序。

questions.stem: The experiment, the results of ( ) were published in a leading journal, has attracted wide attention.
opts: that
which
what
whom
questions.explain: 考点：非限制性定语从句中的介词+关系代词。先行词为The experiment，指物，介词of后应用which，构成"the results of which"引导非限制性定语从句。

questions.stem: So difficult ( ) the problem that few students could solve it in the exam.
opts: it was
was it
it is
is it
questions.explain: 考点：so...that...句型的倒装。"So + 形容词"置于句首时，主句需部分倒装，且根据从句时态could，主句应用过去时，故填was it。

questions.stem: The two theories are fundamentally different; there is no ______ between them.
opts: A. similarity
B. resemblance
C. analogy
D. identity
questions.explain: analogy 指结构或功能上的类比/相似，强调对应关系；similarity/resemblance 侧重外观或性质相似，identity 指完全相同，此处强调理论间的对应类比关系，故选 analogy。

questions.stem: His speech was so ______ that even his opponents were convinced.
opts: A. ambiguous
B. eloquent
C. arrogant
D. tedious
questions.explain: eloquent 意为雄辩的、有说服力的，符合语境；ambiguous 模棱两可，arrogant 傲慢，tedious 乏味，均与说服对手的逻辑矛盾。

questions.stem: The new policy will ______ significant changes in the education system.
opts: A. bring about
B. bring up
C. bring out
D. bring in
questions.explain: bring about 意为引起、导致，常与 change/reform 搭配；bring up 抚养/提出，bring out 出版/使显现，bring in 引入/赚得，只有 bring about 搭配 changes 最恰当。

questions.stem: She has a ______ memory for faces, but often forgets names.
opts: A. remarkable
B. noticeable
C. conspicuous
D. outstanding
questions.explain: remarkable 指值得注意的、非凡的，常修饰 memory/ability；noticeable 强调易被注意到，conspicuous 指显眼的，outstanding 指杰出的，remarkable memory 为习惯搭配。

questions.stem: The company is trying to ______ its market share by launching new products.
opts: A. expand
B. extend
C. enlarge
D. prolong
questions.explain: expand 指范围、规模上的扩大，market share 搭配 expand；extend 多指时间或空间上的延伸，enlarge 指尺寸变大，prolong 指时间延长，只有 expand 与 market share 搭配合理。

questions.stem: His ______ attitude towards work made him unpopular among colleagues.
opts: A. indifferent
B. different
C. diligent
D. distinct
questions.explain: indifferent 意为冷漠的、不关心的，与 unpopular 形成因果逻辑；different 不同的，diligent 勤奋的，distinct 清晰的/不同的，只有 indifferent 能导致 unpopular 的结果。

questions.stem: The doctor advised him to ______ his intake of sugar and salt.
opts: A. reduce
B. decrease
C. decline
D. diminish
questions.explain: reduce 强调人为地使某物数量或程度变小，常与 intake/consumption 搭配；decrease 侧重逐渐减少，decline 指下降/拒绝，diminish 指变弱/减少，reduce intake 为固定搭配。

questions.stem: It is ______ that the project will be completed on time given the current delays.
opts: A. doubtful
B. suspicious
C. questionable
D. uncertain
questions.explain: doubtful 指对某事结果存疑，常用 it is doubtful that... 句型；suspicious 怀疑的（多指不信任），questionable 有问题的，uncertain 不确定的，doubtful 最符合对完成时间的怀疑语气。

questions.stem: The two countries signed a ______ to promote cultural exchange.
opts: A. treaty
B. agreement
C. contract
D. pact
questions.explain: agreement 为最通用的协议/协定，涵盖文化、贸易等多领域；treaty 多指国家间正式条约，contract 侧重商业合同，pact 指契约/公约，agreement 在此语境下最自然通用。

questions.stem: Her ______ comments during the meeting offended several people.
opts: A. blunt
B. dull
C. sharp
D. keen
questions.explain: blunt 指（言语）直率、生硬的，常含冒犯意味；dull 迟钝的，sharp 尖锐的（可褒可贬），keen 敏锐的/热切的，blunt 最能体现 comments 冒犯他人的语义。

questions.stem: Her ______ remarks during the meeting made everyone feel uncomfortable.
opts: A. ambiguous
B. ambitious
C. amiable
D. ample
questions.explain: ambiguous 意为‘模棱两可的、含糊的’，符合‘令人不适的言论’语境；ambitious 是‘有雄心的’，amiable 是‘和蔼的’，ample 是‘充足的’，均不吻合。

questions.stem: He is a ______ collector of antique coins, having spent decades building his collection.
opts: A. devoted
B. devout
C. dedicated
D. dictated
questions.explain: dedicated 强调‘专注的、投入的’，与‘花费数十年收集’呼应；devoted 侧重‘忠诚的’，devout 指‘虔诚的’，dictated 是‘口述的’，均不贴切。

questions.stem: The professor asked the students to ______ the main points of the article in one paragraph.
opts: A. compress
B. condense
C. comprise
D. compromise
questions.explain: condense 意为‘压缩、精简’，特指文字或内容的浓缩；compress 多指物理压缩，comprise 是‘包含’，compromise 是‘妥协’。

questions.stem: The company's financial situation is ______; we need to take immediate action.
opts: A. delicate
B. delicious
C. deliberate
D. desperate
questions.explain: delicate 可表示‘微妙的、棘手的’，形容财务状况需要立即行动；delicious 是‘美味的’，deliberate 是‘故意的’，desperate 是‘绝望的’，程度过重。

questions.stem: His speech was so ______ that the audience could not understand his main argument.
opts: A. coherent
B. concise
C. concrete
D. confusing
questions.explain: confusing 意为‘令人困惑的’，与‘听众无法理解’直接对应；coherent 是‘连贯的’，concise 是‘简洁的’，concrete 是‘具体的’，均与句意相反。

questions.stem: The two countries signed a trade ______ to promote economic cooperation.
opts: A. contract
B. contact
C. contest
D. context
questions.explain: contract 意为‘合同、协议’，符合‘签署贸易协议’；contact 是‘联系’，contest 是‘比赛’，context 是‘上下文’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: She tried to ______ her disappointment with a smile.
opts: A. conceal
B. concede
C. conceive
D. confess
questions.explain: conceal 意为‘隐藏、掩饰’，符合‘用微笑掩饰失望’；concede 是‘承认’，conceive 是‘构想’，confess 是‘坦白’，均不吻合。

questions.stem: The experiment must be conducted under ______ conditions to ensure accuracy.
opts: A. controlled
B. comfortable
C. complicated
D. comparable
questions.explain: controlled 意为‘受控制的’，与‘确保准确性’的实验条件匹配；comfortable 是‘舒适的’，complicated 是‘复杂的’，comparable 是‘可比较的’，均不准确。

questions.stem: The two sisters are so alike that I can hardly ______ one from the other.
opts: distinguish
contrast
separate
compare
questions.explain: distinguish A from B 意为“区分、辨别”，符合句意；contrast 强调对比差异，separate 强调分离，compare 强调比较异同。

questions.stem: The new policy will ______ significant changes in the company's management.
opts: bring about
bring up
bring in
bring out
questions.explain: bring about 意为“导致、引起”，搭配 changes 最恰当；bring up 意为“抚养/提出”，bring in 意为“引入”，bring out 意为“使显现”。

questions.stem: He was ______ of having failed to keep his promise.
opts: ashamed
shameful
shameless
embarrassed
questions.explain: be ashamed of 为固定搭配，意为“对……感到羞愧”；shameful 形容事物“可耻的”，shameless 形容人“无耻的”，embarrassed 后常接 at/by。

questions.stem: The teacher asked the students to ______ the main points of the lecture.
opts: sum up
summon
assume
consume
questions.explain: sum up 意为“总结、概括”，符合语境；summon 意为“召唤”，assume 意为“假设”，consume 意为“消耗”。

questions.stem: We should ______ every opportunity to improve our English.
opts: make use of
take part in
catch up with
put up with
questions.explain: make use of 意为“利用”，与 opportunity 搭配恰当；take part in 意为“参加”，catch up with 意为“赶上”，put up with 意为“忍受”。

questions.stem: The experiment ______ that the theory is correct.
opts: confirms
conforms
confesses
confuses
questions.explain: confirm 意为“证实”，符合句意；conform 意为“遵守、符合”，confess 意为“承认（过错）”，confuse 意为“使困惑”。

questions.stem: It is not polite to ______ at people when they make mistakes.
opts: laugh
smile
grin
sneer
questions.explain: sneer at 意为“嘲笑、讥讽”，含贬义；laugh at 也可表示“嘲笑”，但 sneer 更强调轻蔑，且四个选项中只有 sneer 直接搭配 at 表贬义更贴切。

questions.stem: The manager ______ the employee for his excellent performance.
opts: praised
appreciated
complimented
congratulated
questions.explain: praise sb for sth 意为“因……表扬某人”，为固定搭配；appreciate 后直接接事物，compliment sb on sth，congratulate sb on sth。

questions.stem: The two countries have ______ a trade agreement.
opts: entered into
entered for
entered on
entered up
questions.explain: enter into 意为“达成（协议）、开始（关系）”，与 agreement 搭配；enter for 意为“报名参加”，enter on/upon 意为“开始”，enter up 意为“登记”。

questions.stem: His speech was so ______ that everyone was moved to tears.
opts: inspiring
inspired
inspirational
inspiration
questions.explain: inspiring 意为“鼓舞人心的”，修饰物用-ing 形式；inspired 意为“受到鼓舞的”修饰人，inspirational 为形容词“启发灵感的”，inspiration 为名词。

questions.stem: The two theories are ______ in their basic assumptions, though they differ in details.
opts: similar
familiar
alike
identical
questions.explain: similar 指大致相似；familiar 意为熟悉的；alike 常作表语；identical 指完全一致，题干说细节不同，故选 similar。

questions.stem: He ______ his success to hard work and a bit of luck.
opts: contributed
attributed
distributed
tributed
questions.explain: attribute...to 把……归因于；contribute to 贡献；distribute 分配；tribute 是名词，故选 attributed。

questions.stem: She has a ______ memory for names and faces.
opts: remarkable
noticeable
observable
applicable
questions.explain: remarkable 非凡的/值得注意的；noticeable 显而易见的；observable 可观察到的；applicable 适用的，形容记忆力好常用 remarkable。

questions.stem: The government is ______ measures to control inflation.
opts: adapting
adopting
adjusting
admitting
questions.explain: adopt measures 采取/采纳措施；adapt 适应/改编；adjust 调整；admit 承认/准许进入，固定搭配为 adopt measures。

questions.stem: His speech was so ______ that many listeners were moved to tears.
opts: inspiring
perspiring
expiring
aspiring
questions.explain: inspiring 鼓舞人心的；perspiring 出汗的；expiring 到期的/断气的；aspiring 有抱负的，根据语境应选 inspiring。

questions.stem: The two countries have ______ a trade agreement after months of negotiation.
opts: entered into
entered for
entered on
entered upon
questions.explain: enter into 缔结/开始（协议、关系等）；enter for 报名参加；enter on/upon 开始/着手，与 agreement 搭配用 enter into。

questions.stem: The experiment ______ the researchers' hypothesis that the drug is effective.
opts: confirmed
conformed
confined
confused
questions.explain: confirm 证实/确认；conform 遵守/符合（常与 to 连用）；confine 限制；confuse 使困惑，与 hypothesis 搭配用 confirmed。

questions.stem: She ______ her colleagues by arriving late for every meeting.
opts: aggravated
aggregated
alleviated
accelerated
questions.explain: aggravate 使恶化/激怒；aggregate 总计/聚集；alleviate 减轻/缓解；accelerate 加速，根据语境应选 aggravated（激怒同事）。

questions.stem: The two theories are fundamentally different; there is a clear ______ between them.
opts: distinction
extinction
distraction
destruction
questions.explain: distinction 意为“区别、差别”，符合句意；extinction 指“灭绝”，distraction 指“分心”，destruction 指“破坏”，均为形近干扰。

questions.stem: The company decided to ______ the old equipment with more advanced models.
opts: replace
recover
rebuild
recycle
questions.explain: replace A with B 意为“用 B 替换 A”，符合语境；recover 意为“恢复”，rebuild 意为“重建”，recycle 意为“回收利用”。

questions.stem: Her speech was so ______ that everyone in the audience was moved to tears.
opts: inspiring
insulting
invading
insisting
questions.explain: inspiring 意为“鼓舞人心的”，与“感动落泪”的语境一致；insulting 意为“侮辱的”，invading 意为“入侵的”，insisting 意为“坚持的”。

questions.stem: The scientist spent years trying to ______ the truth behind the mysterious phenomenon.
opts: uncover
undergo
undertake
unload
questions.explain: uncover 意为“揭露、发现”，与“寻找真相”搭配；undergo 意为“经历”，undertake 意为“承担”，unload 意为“卸货”。

questions.stem: He is a very ______ person; he always keeps his promises and never tells lies.
opts: reliable
remarkable
reluctant
relevant
questions.explain: reliable 意为“可靠的”，与“信守承诺、从不说谎”对应；remarkable 意为“显著的”，reluctant 意为“不情愿的”，relevant 意为“相关的”。

questions.stem: The teacher asked the students to ______ the main idea of the passage in one sentence.
opts: sum up
summon
consume
assume
questions.explain: sum up 意为“总结、概括”，与“用一句话概括主旨”匹配；summon 意为“召唤”，consume 意为“消耗”，assume 意为“假设”。

questions.stem: The two countries have signed a trade ______ to promote economic cooperation.
opts: agreement
argument
assignment
amusement
questions.explain: agreement 意为“协议、协定”，与“签署贸易协议”搭配；argument 意为“争论”，assignment 意为“任务”，amusement 意为“娱乐”。

questions.stem: The doctor advised him to ______ his intake of sugar and salt for health reasons.
opts: reduce
reproduce
renew
reflect
questions.explain: reduce 意为“减少”，与“控制糖盐摄入”的语境一致；reproduce 意为“复制”，renew 意为“更新”，reflect 意为“反映”。

questions.stem: The sudden ______ of the storm took everyone by surprise.
opts: outbreak
outcome
outlook
outline
questions.explain: outbreak 意为“爆发”，常指战争、疾病或风暴的突然发生；outcome 意为“结果”，outlook 意为“展望”，outline 意为“大纲”。

questions.stem: The new policy is ______ to fail unless we get more support from the public.
opts: bound
determined
doomed
resolved
questions.explain: be doomed to fail 意为‘注定失败’，而 bound 后接不定式表‘一定会做某事’，但 bound to fail 侧重‘必然失败’，doomed 更强调‘厄运难逃’。

questions.stem: She was ______ with grief when she heard the tragic news.
opts: overwhelmed
surrounded
covered
flooded
questions.explain: be overwhelmed with grief 是固定搭配，意为‘悲痛欲绝’，其他选项搭配不当。

questions.stem: The two theories are ______ different; one is based on deduction, the other on induction.
opts: fundamentally
basically
essentially
radically
questions.explain: radically different 强调‘根本性的、彻底的差异’，程度最强；fundamentally/basically/essentially 更侧重‘本质上’。

questions.stem: He tried to ______ his anger during the heated debate.
opts: restrain
refrain
constrain
contain
questions.explain: contain one's anger 意为‘克制/控制住愤怒’；restrain 后常接 sb./sth. from doing；refrain 是不及物动词，后接 from；constrain 意为‘强迫，限制’。

questions.stem: The government has ______ new measures to combat inflation.
opts: adapted
adopted
adjusted
adhered
questions.explain: adopt measures 意为‘采取措施’；adapt 意为‘适应’；adjust 意为‘调整’；adhere 后接 to，意为‘坚持’。

questions.stem: His speech was so ______ that many listeners fell asleep.
opts: tedious
curious
spacious
gracious
questions.explain: tedious 意为‘冗长乏味的’，符合‘听众睡着’的语境；curious 好奇的；spacious 宽敞的；gracious 优雅的。

questions.stem: The scientist ______ the experiment several times before publishing the results.
opts: repeated
reproduced
replicated
renewed
questions.explain: replicate an experiment 是科研常用搭配，意为‘重复实验以验证结果’；repeat 侧重‘重复做’；reproduce 侧重‘复制、再现’；renew 侧重‘更新’。

questions.stem: The company's profits have ______ sharply over the past three months.
opts: decreased
declined
dropped
diminished
questions.explain: drop sharply 是常见搭配，强调‘急剧下降’；decrease/decline/diminish 虽也有‘下降’义，但 drop 与 sharply 搭配更自然、更常用。

questions.stem: He was ______ of stealing the confidential documents.
opts: accused
charged
suspected
blamed
questions.explain: be accused of 意为‘被指控犯有……罪’；be charged with 后接罪名；be suspected of 意为‘被怀疑’；be blamed for 意为‘因……被责备’。

questions.stem: The beauty of the sunset is beyond ______; words cannot describe it.
opts: expression
description
imagination
comparison
questions.explain: beyond description 是固定短语，意为‘难以形容’；beyond expression 较少用；beyond imagination 意为‘超乎想象’；beyond comparison 意为‘无与伦比’。

questions.stem: The government has taken measures to ______ the spread of the epidemic.
opts: restrain
retain
sustain
contain
questions.explain: contain 意为“控制、遏制”，常与 disease/spread 搭配；restrain 是“阻止某人做某事”，retain 是“保留”，sustain 是“维持”，搭配对象不同。

questions.stem: He is a very ______ person and always arrives on time for appointments.
opts: punctual
punctured
punctilious
punctualized
questions.explain: punctual 意为“守时的”，符合语境；punctured 是“被刺破的”，punctilious 是“一丝不苟的（侧重细节）”，punctualized 非标准词。

questions.stem: The scientist's ______ discovery revolutionized the field of genetics.
opts: precedent
precious
preliminary
pioneering
questions.explain: pioneering 意为“开创性的”，与 discovery 搭配恰当；precedent 是“先例”，precious 是“珍贵的”，preliminary 是“初步的”，语义侧重不同。

questions.stem: The manager tried to ______ the conflict between the two departments.
opts: mediate
meditate
meddle
merge
questions.explain: mediate 意为“调解、斡旋”，常与 conflict/dispute 搭配；meditate 是“冥想”，meddle 是“干涉”，merge 是“合并”，形近义异。

questions.stem: The data collected from the experiment is not ______ with the hypothesis.
opts: consistent
constant
content
consequent
questions.explain: consistent 意为“一致的”，be consistent with 是固定搭配；constant 是“恒定的”，content 是“满足的/内容”，consequent 是“随之发生的”，搭配与词义均不同。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that most students fell asleep.
opts: tedious
tempting
tender
tense
questions.explain: tedious 意为“冗长乏味的”，符合导致学生睡觉的语境；tempting 是“诱人的”，tender 是“温柔的”，tense 是“紧张的”，语义不符。

questions.stem: The company decided to ______ the old factory and build a new one.
opts: demolish
diminish
demand
demonstrate
questions.explain: demolish 意为“拆除、拆毁”，与 factory/build 搭配；diminish 是“减少”，demand 是“要求”，demonstrate 是“展示”，形近词辨析。

questions.stem: The two theories are fundamentally different; there is a clear ________ between them.
opts: distinction
distraction
distribution
distortion
questions.explain: distinction 意为‘区别、差异’，符合句意‘两者之间有明显的区别’；distraction 意为‘分心’，distribution 意为‘分配’，distortion 意为‘扭曲’，均不符合。

questions.stem: The new policy will ________ significant changes in the education system.
opts: bring about
bring up
bring out
bring in
questions.explain: bring about 意为‘导致、引起’，与‘significant changes’搭配合理；bring up 意为‘抚养、提出’，bring out 意为‘出版、使显现’，bring in 意为‘引入、赚得’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: She has a strong ________ for classical music, which she inherited from her parents.
opts: appreciation
apprehension
application
approval
questions.explain: appreciation 意为‘欣赏、鉴赏’，符合‘对古典音乐有强烈欣赏’的语境；apprehension 意为‘忧虑、理解’，application 意为‘申请、应用’，approval 意为‘批准、赞同’，均不贴切。

questions.stem: The company decided to ________ the project due to a lack of funds.
opts: abandon
abolish
abstain
absorb
questions.explain: abandon 意为‘放弃（项目、计划等）’，符合‘因资金不足放弃项目’；abolish 意为‘废除（制度、法律等）’，abstain 意为‘戒除、弃权’，absorb 意为‘吸收’，均不合适。

questions.stem: His speech was so ________ that everyone in the audience felt inspired.
opts: eloquent
elegant
elaborate
elementary
questions.explain: eloquent 意为‘雄辩的、有口才的’，与‘令人鼓舞的演讲’语境吻合；elegant 意为‘优雅的’，elaborate 意为‘精心制作的’，elementary 意为‘基础的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: The scientist tried to ________ the results of the experiment to the public in simple terms.
opts: convey
convince
convert
confine
questions.explain: convey 意为‘传达、传递（信息）’，符合‘用简单术语向公众传达实验结果’；convince 意为‘使信服’，convert 意为‘转变’，confine 意为‘限制’，均不适用。

questions.stem: The two countries signed a ________ to promote mutual economic cooperation.
opts: treaty
treat
trait
trial
questions.explain: treaty 意为‘条约、协定’，符合‘两国签署条约促进经济合作’；treat 意为‘对待、款待’，trait 意为‘特征’，trial 意为‘试验、审判’，均不符合。

questions.stem: Her ________ of the poem was so moving that many listeners had tears in their eyes.
opts: recitation
repetition
rejection
recreation
questions.explain: recitation 意为‘朗诵、背诵’，与‘朗诵诗歌令人感动’语境相符；repetition 意为‘重复’，rejection 意为‘拒绝’，recreation 意为‘娱乐、消遣’，均不贴切。

questions.stem: The manager asked the staff to ________ the report before submitting it.
opts: revise
reverse
revolt
revive
questions.explain: revise 意为‘修订、修改’，符合‘提交前修改报告’的要求；reverse 意为‘逆转、倒转’，revolt 意为‘反抗、起义’，revive 意为‘复兴、复活’，均不合适。

questions.stem: It is important to ________ your emotions when dealing with a crisis.
opts: regulate
reject
relate
release
questions.explain: regulate 意为‘调节、管控’，与‘在危机中管控情绪’的语境吻合；reject 意为‘拒绝’，relate 意为‘关联、叙述’，release 意为‘释放’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: The manager tried to ______ the conflict between the two departments before it escalated.
opts: resolve
revolve
involve
dissolve
questions.explain: resolve 意为‘解决（问题、冲突）’，符合语境‘解决冲突’；revolve 是‘旋转’，involve 是‘涉及’，dissolve 是‘溶解、解散’。

questions.stem: Her speech was so ______ that many audience members were moved to tears.
opts: inspiring
insisting
persisting
consisting
questions.explain: inspiring 意为‘鼓舞人心的’，符合‘听众感动落泪’的语境；insisting 是‘坚持’，persisting 是‘持续’，consisting 是‘由……组成’。

questions.stem: The new policy will ______ significant changes in the company's management structure.
opts: bring about
bring up
bring in
bring out
questions.explain: bring about 意为‘引起、导致’，符合‘政策带来变化’的语义；bring up 是‘抚养、提出’，bring in 是‘引入、赚得’，bring out 是‘出版、使显现’。

questions.stem: He is an ______ student who always finishes his assignments ahead of schedule.
opts: industrious
indigenous
indignant
indispensable
questions.explain: industrious 意为‘勤奋的’，与‘总是提前完成作业’对应；indigenous 是‘本土的’，indignant 是‘愤怒的’，indispensable 是‘不可或缺的’。

questions.stem: The government should take ______ measures to protect the environment.
opts: effective
efficient
affective
infective
questions.explain: effective 意为‘有效的’，修饰‘措施’表示‘有效措施’；efficient 是‘高效率的’，affective 是‘情感的’，infective 是‘传染性的’。

questions.stem: The two countries signed a trade ______ to boost economic cooperation.
opts: agreement
aggressive
agreeable
agriculture
questions.explain: agreement 意为‘协议、协定’，与‘签署贸易……’搭配；aggressive 是‘侵略的’，agreeable 是‘令人愉快的’，agriculture 是‘农业’。

questions.stem: The company is ______ for its high-quality products and excellent service.
opts: renowned
renewed
repeated
rejected
questions.explain: renowned 意为‘著名的’，与‘因其高质量产品和服务而……’搭配；renewed 是‘更新的’，repeated 是‘重复的’，rejected 是‘被拒绝的’。

questions.stem: The professor's ______ remarks during the lecture left the students utterly confused, as they could not discern any coherent argument.
opts: A. perspicuous
B. desultory
C. trenchant
D. cogent
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：desultory 意为‘散漫的、无条理的’，符合‘让学生困惑、找不到连贯论点’的语境；perspicuous 清晰易懂，trenchant 犀利尖锐，cogent 有说服力，均与句意相反。

questions.stem: Despite the company's public claims of transparency, the internal report was filled with ______ language that obscured the real financial situation.
opts: A. limpid
B. recondite
C. lucid
D. unequivocal
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：recondite 意为‘晦涩难懂的’，与‘obscured the real situation’呼应；limpid/lucid 清澈明晰，unequivocal 明确不含糊，均与句意矛盾。

questions.stem: The politician's speech was so ______ that even his supporters found it difficult to extract any concrete policy proposals.
opts: A. pellucid
B. bombastic
C. succinct
D. incisive
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：bombastic 意为‘浮夸的、空洞的’，符合‘难以提取具体政策’的语境；pellucid 清晰明了，succinct 简洁的，incisive 一针见血的，均与句意相反。

questions.stem: Her ______ approach to problem-solving — jumping from one idea to another without any logical connection — frustrated her methodical colleagues.
opts: A. systematic
B. discursive
C. methodical
D. linear
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：discursive 意为‘东拉西扯的、散漫的’，与‘从一个想法跳到另一个、无逻辑连接’的描述完全吻合；systematic/methodical/linear 均指有条理、有逻辑，与句意相反。

questions.stem: The author's ______ prose, laden with obscure allusions and convoluted syntax, alienated the general readership.
opts: A. accessible
B. esoteric
C. straightforward
D. transparent
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：esoteric 意为‘深奥难懂的、只有少数人能理解的’，与‘晦涩的典故、复杂的句法’及‘疏远普通读者’的语境匹配；accessible/straightforward/transparent 均指易懂的，与句意相反。

questions.stem: The CEO's ______ statement, which seemed to say everything yet nothing at all, was a masterclass in corporate obfuscation.
opts: A. equivocal
B. unambiguous
C. explicit
D. categorical
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：equivocal 意为‘模棱两可的、含糊的’，与‘似乎什么都说了又什么都没说’及‘corporate obfuscation（企业混淆视听）’完美对应；unambiguous/explicit/categorical 均指明确清晰的，与句意相反。

questions.stem: While the novice writer used simple, direct language, the veteran journalist's style was far more ______, rich with nuance and layered meaning.
opts: A. simplistic
B. nuanced
C. bald
D. stark
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：nuanced 意为‘细致微妙的、有层次的’，与‘rich with nuance and layered meaning’直接对应；simplistic 过分简单的，bald 直白的，stark 鲜明的/赤裸的，均不符合‘有细微差别’的语境。

questions.stem: The diplomat's ______ response — polite but revealing nothing — was a textbook example of how to avoid a direct answer.
opts: A. evasive
B. forthright
C. candid
D. ingenuous
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：evasive 意为‘回避的、闪烁其词的’，与‘礼貌但未透露任何信息、避免直接回答’的语境完全吻合；forthright/candid/ingenuous 均指坦率直白的，与句意相反。

questions.stem: The critic dismissed the film as ______, claiming it merely recycled tired tropes without any original insight.
opts: A. innovative
B. derivative
C. groundbreaking
D. pioneering
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：derivative 意为‘缺乏独创性的、模仿他人的’，与‘recycled tired tropes（重复老套桥段）’及‘没有原创见解’的语境匹配；innovative/groundbreaking/pioneering 均指创新的，与句意相反。

questions.stem: His ______ memory for trivial details astonished his friends, though he often forgot important appointments.
opts: A. fallible
B. tenacious
C. porous
D. selective
questions.explain: 词汇辨析：tenacious 意为‘持久的、牢固的’，tenacious memory 指‘记忆力极强’，与‘对琐碎细节的记忆令人惊讶’一致；fallible 易出错的，porous 多孔的（比喻记不住），selective 有选择的，均不能体现‘惊人记忆力’的褒义色彩。

questions.stem: The professor's ______ remarks during the lecture left the students utterly bewildered, as they contradicted the textbook's core arguments.
opts: enigmatic
lucid
pedantic
redundant
questions.explain: enigmatic 意为‘费解的、神秘的’，符合‘让学生困惑’的语境；lucid（清晰的）、pedantic（迂腐的）、redundant（冗余的）均不匹配。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's attempt to ______ the financial scandal, the leaked documents exposed the full extent of the embezzlement.
opts: obfuscate
elucidate
corroborate
disseminate
questions.explain: obfuscate 意为‘使模糊、混淆’，符合‘掩盖丑闻’的语义；elucidate（阐明）、corroborate（证实）、disseminate（散布）方向相反。

questions.stem: The author's writing style is remarkably ______, employing a vast lexicon and intricate syntax that challenges even seasoned readers.
opts: laconic
verbose
terse
succinct
questions.explain: verbose 意为‘冗长的、啰嗦的’，与‘大量词汇、复杂句法’对应；laconic/terse/succinct 均表示简洁，与语境矛盾。

questions.stem: The two theories are not mutually exclusive; rather, they ______ each other in explaining the phenomenon of cognitive dissonance.
opts: repudiate
complement
undermine
supersede
questions.explain: complement 意为‘补充、相辅相成’，符合‘not mutually exclusive’的提示；repudiate（否定）、undermine（削弱）、supersede（取代）均表对立。

questions.stem: His ______ attitude toward the new policy—praising it publicly while sabotaging it privately—was seen as deeply hypocritical.
opts: ambivalent
dichotomous
equivocal
duplicitous
questions.explain: duplicitous 意为‘两面派的、奸诈的’，精准描述‘公开赞扬、私下破坏’的行为；ambivalent（矛盾）、dichotomous（二分的）、equivocal（模棱两可）均不如 duplicitous 贴合‘虚伪’这一核心。

questions.stem: The historian argued that the emperor's decision was not a ______ act of tyranny but a calculated response to an impending rebellion.
opts: capricious
judicious
benevolent
pragmatic
questions.explain: capricious 意为‘反复无常的、任性的’，与‘calculated response（深思熟虑的回应）’形成对比；judicious（明智的）、benevolent（仁慈的）、pragmatic（务实的）均为正面词，不符合‘tyranny’的否定语境。

questions.stem: The novel's protagonist undergoes a gradual ______ from naive idealism to cynical realism, mirroring the author's own disillusionment.
opts: metamorphosis
stagnation
regression
ossification
questions.explain: metamorphosis 意为‘蜕变、质变’，强调根本性的转变，与‘from...to...’的渐进变化吻合；stagnation（停滞）、regression（倒退）、ossification（僵化）均不能体现‘转变’这一核心。

questions.stem: The diplomat's speech was deliberately ______, avoiding any direct commitment while appearing to address the crisis.
opts: candid
unequivocal
circumlocutory
dogmatic
questions.explain: circumlocutory 意为‘迂回的、兜圈子的’，与‘avoiding direct commitment’直接对应；candid（坦率的）、unequivocal（明确的）、dogmatic（教条的）均与回避表态的语境相悖。

questions.stem: The data from the experiment are ______ with the hypothesis that sleep deprivation impairs memory consolidation.
opts: congruent
antithetical
irrelevant
spurious
questions.explain: congruent 意为‘一致的、相符的’，常与 with 搭配表示‘与……一致’；antithetical（对立的）、irrelevant（不相关的）、spurious（虚假的）均不符合‘支持假设’的语义。

questions.stem: The CEO's ______ management style—micromanaging every detail while ignoring strategic planning—ultimately led to the company's decline.
opts: meticulous
desultory
charismatic
visionary
questions.explain: desultory 意为‘散漫的、无条理的’，与‘micromanaging细节却忽视战略’的矛盾行为吻合；meticulous（一丝不苟的）偏褒义，charismatic（有魅力的）和 visionary（有远见的）均为正面词，不符合导致衰落的负面语境。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the most diligent students found themselves struggling to keep up with the thread of his argument.
opts: A. lucid
B. abstruse
C. banal
D. terse
questions.explain: 考点：abstruse（深奥难懂的）与上下文'struggling to keep up'语义匹配；lucid（清晰易懂）与句意相反，banal（平庸的）和terse（简练的）均不构成理解困难的原因。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ remarks about the company's future, the quarterly report revealed a staggering loss that contradicted every one of his claims.
opts: A. sanguine
B. somber
C. laconic
D. equivocal
questions.explain: 考点：sanguine（乐观的）与后半句'staggering loss'形成强烈反差；somber（阴郁的）与语境矛盾，laconic（寡言的）和equivocal（模棱两可的）无法体现'contradicted every claim'所需的明确乐观态度。

questions.stem: The author's writing style is so ______ that readers often need to consult a dictionary multiple times per page.
opts: A. pedestrian
B. sesquipedalian
C. colloquial
D. vernacular
questions.explain: 考点：sesquipedalian（多音节的/冗长的）特指用词冗长晦涩，与'consult a dictionary'直接对应；pedestrian（平淡的）、colloquial（口语的）、vernacular（方言的）均不导致查字典行为。

questions.stem: The witness's testimony was ______; she changed her account of the incident three times during cross-examination.
opts: A. consistent
B. veracious
C. vacillating
D. dogmatic
questions.explain: 考点：vacillating（摇摆不定的）与'changed her account three times'完全对应；consistent（一致的）和veracious（诚实的）与句意相反，dogmatic（教条的）侧重固执而非反复变化。

questions.stem: The diplomat's ______ response to the journalist's provocative question prevented the situation from escalating into a diplomatic crisis.
opts: A. incendiary
B. truculent
C. tactful
D. brusque
questions.explain: 考点：tactful（圆滑得体的）与'prevented the situation from escalating'因果一致；incendiary（煽动性的）、truculent（好斗的）、brusque（粗鲁的）均会导致矛盾升级而非化解。

questions.stem: The new policy was ______ by the opposition as an attempt to suppress freedom of speech, though the government defended it as necessary for national security.
opts: A. lauded
B. decried
C. mooted
D. ratified
questions.explain: 考点：decried（公开谴责）与'opposition'和'suppress freedom of speech'的负面评价一致；lauded（赞扬）和ratified（批准）与opposition立场矛盾，mooted（提出讨论）语气中性，无法体现谴责意味。

questions.stem: Her ______ nature made her an excellent negotiator, as she could always find a middle ground between opposing viewpoints.
opts: A. intransigent
B. mercurial
C. conciliatory
D. dogmatic
questions.explain: 考点：conciliatory（安抚的/和解的）与'find a middle ground'直接对应；intransigent（不妥协的）和dogmatic（固执己见的）与谈判成功矛盾，mercurial（善变的）侧重情绪多变而非调和能力。

questions.stem: The critic's review was surprisingly ______, praising the film's cinematography while acknowledging its weak plot.
opts: A. vitriolic
B. effusive
C. balanced
D. scathing
questions.explain: 考点：balanced（平衡的）与'praising...while acknowledging...'的并列正反评价对应；vitriolic（尖刻的）和scathing（严厉批评的）只含负面，effusive（溢于言表的）只含正面，均无法涵盖句中的双重态度。

questions.stem: The CEO's ______ decision to invest in renewable energy was praised by environmentalists but criticized by shareholders who prioritized short-term profits.
opts: A. myopic
B. prescient
C. reckless
D. capricious
questions.explain: 考点：prescient（有先见之明的）与'praised by environmentalists'及长期投资方向一致；myopic（目光短浅的）和reckless（鲁莽的）含贬义，与环保人士的赞扬矛盾，capricious（反复无常的）强调随意性而非远见。

questions.stem: The politician's speech was filled with ______ language, carefully avoiding any concrete commitments while appearing to address every concern.
opts: A. unequivocal
B. ambiguous
C. strident
D. cogent
questions.explain: 考点：ambiguous（模棱两可的）与'avoiding any concrete commitments'完全对应；unequivocal（明确的）和cogent（有说服力的）与回避承诺矛盾，strident（刺耳的）侧重语气而非模糊性。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the most diligent students struggled to follow his line of reasoning.
opts: abstruse
ambiguous
superficial
articulate
questions.explain: abstruse 意为‘深奥难懂的’，与后文‘最勤奋的学生都难以跟上’逻辑一致；ambiguous 指歧义模糊，superficial 指肤浅，articulate 指表达清晰，均不符合语境。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ apology, the board remained unconvinced and demanded a more detailed explanation of the financial irregularities.
opts: cursory
contrite
eloquent
cogent
questions.explain: cursory 意为‘草率的、敷衍的’，与后文‘董事会不买账、要求更详细解释’形成因果逻辑；contrite 是‘忏悔的’，eloquent 是‘雄辩的’，cogent 是‘有说服力的’，均与语境矛盾。

questions.stem: The historian argued that the revolution was not a sudden rupture but a gradual ______ of social and economic tensions.
opts: culmination
catalyst
conflagration
concatenation
questions.explain: concatenation 意为‘一系列相互关联的事件/连锁’，强调渐进积累的过程；culmination 是‘顶点’，catalyst 是‘催化剂’，conflagration 是‘大火/冲突’，均不能准确表达‘逐步串联’的含义。

questions.stem: Her ______ remarks during the debate alienated even her staunchest supporters, who found them unnecessarily harsh.
opts: vitriolic
verbose
vapid
vindictive
questions.explain: vitriolic 意为‘尖酸刻薄的’，与后文‘连最坚定的支持者都觉得过于刻薄’吻合；verbose 是‘冗长的’，vapid 是‘乏味的’，vindictive 是‘报复性的’，均不直接对应‘言语刻薄’。

questions.stem: The new policy is not a panacea; it is merely a ______ measure designed to buy time until a more comprehensive solution can be implemented.
opts: palliative
preemptive
proactive
punitive
questions.explain: palliative 意为‘治标不治本的、权宜之计’，与‘buy time（争取时间）’及‘更全面的解决方案’形成对比；preemptive 是‘先发制人的’，proactive 是‘主动的’，punitive 是‘惩罚性的’，均不符合‘临时缓解’的语义。

questions.stem: The novelist's style is characterized by a ______ of realism and fantasy, blending gritty urban details with magical elements.
opts: synthesis
sycophancy
synopsis
symmetry
questions.explain: synthesis 意为‘综合/融合’，准确描述现实主义与奇幻元素的结合；sycophancy 是‘谄媚’，synopsis 是‘概要’，symmetry 是‘对称’，均与语境无关。

questions.stem: The CEO's decision to downsize the R&D department was widely criticized as ______, prioritizing short-term profits over long-term innovation.
opts: myopic
meticulous
munificent
malleable
questions.explain: myopic 意为‘目光短浅的’，与‘优先短期利润而牺牲长期创新’完美对应；meticulous 是‘一丝不苟的’，munificent 是‘慷慨的’，malleable 是‘可塑的/易受影响的’，均不合逻辑。

questions.stem: The diplomat's ______ handling of the sensitive negotiations prevented the dispute from escalating into a full-blown crisis.
opts: adroit
arduous
aloof
abrasive
questions.explain: adroit 意为‘机敏的/老练的’，与‘防止争端升级为全面危机’的正面结果一致；arduous 是‘艰苦的’，aloof 是‘冷漠的’，abrasive 是‘粗暴的’，均不符合褒义语境。

questions.stem: The critic dismissed the film as a mere ______ of earlier, more original works, lacking any creative merit of its own.
opts: pastiche
paragon
paradigm
parody
questions.explain: pastiche 意为‘拼凑模仿之作’，特指缺乏原创性的模仿品；paragon 是‘典范’，paradigm 是‘范式’，parody 是‘滑稽模仿/恶搞’，虽与模仿有关但侧重讽刺效果，而pastiche更强调‘拼凑无创新’，与‘缺乏创意’最匹配。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the most diligent students struggled to follow the thread of his argument.
opts: abstruse
superficial
ludicrous
banal
questions.explain: abstruse 意为‘深奥难懂的’，与后文‘最勤奋的学生都难以跟上’语义吻合；superficial（肤浅的）、ludicrous（荒唐的）、banal（平庸的）均不符合语境。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ speech, the employees remained skeptical about the promised reforms.
opts: eloquent
reticent
indifferent
ambiguous
questions.explain: eloquent 意为‘雄辩的、有说服力的’，与 despite 转折逻辑匹配——尽管演讲很有说服力，员工仍持怀疑态度；reticent（缄默的）、indifferent（冷漠的）、ambiguous（模棱两可的）均不合逻辑。

questions.stem: The historian argued that the treaty was not a genuine peace but merely a ______ of hostilities.
opts: cessation
resumption
prelude
suspension
questions.explain: cessation 意为‘停止、中止’，与‘not a genuine peace but merely a cessation of hostilities’（并非真正和平，仅是停战）语义匹配；resumption（恢复）、prelude（序幕）、suspension（暂停，常含暂缓意味）均不如 cessation 精准。

questions.stem: Her ______ remarks during the negotiation nearly derailed the entire agreement.
opts: judicious
tactless
diplomatic
conciliatory
questions.explain: tactless 意为‘不圆通的、不得体的’，与‘几乎破坏整个协议’的负面结果一致；judicious（明智的）、diplomatic（老练的）、conciliatory（安抚的）均为正面或中性词，无法导致协议破裂。

questions.stem: The novel's protagonist is a deeply ______ character, torn between duty and desire.
opts: ambiguous
ambivalent
apathetic
arbitrary
questions.explain: ambivalent 意为‘矛盾心理的’，特指同时存在两种相反情感，与‘在责任与欲望间挣扎’完美对应；ambiguous（模棱两可的，多指含义不清）、apathetic（冷漠的）、arbitrary（任意的）均不匹配。

questions.stem: The government's ______ response to the crisis only exacerbated the public's panic.
opts: prompt
tepid
vigorous
decisive
questions.explain: tepid 意为‘不温不火的、冷淡的’，与‘加剧公众恐慌’的负面结果一致；prompt（迅速的）、vigorous（有力的）、decisive（果断的）均为正面词，不会加剧恐慌。

questions.stem: His ______ account of the incident contradicted all the eyewitness testimonies.
opts: corroborated
fabricated
circumstantial
plausible
questions.explain: fabricated 意为‘捏造的’，与‘与所有目击证词矛盾’的语境吻合；corroborated（被证实的）与矛盾逻辑相反，circumstantial（间接的）和 plausible（看似合理的）均不必然导致矛盾。

questions.stem: The artist's later works are characterized by a ______ of color and form that critics found unsettling.
opts: synthesis
profusion
paucity
subversion
questions.explain: subversion 意为‘颠覆、破坏’，与‘评论家感到不安’的负面评价一致，指对色彩与形式的颠覆性运用；synthesis（综合）、profusion（大量）、paucity（匮乏）均无法体现‘不安’的批评反应。

questions.stem: A truly ______ leader must be willing to admit mistakes and learn from them.
opts: arrogant
magnanimous
dogmatic
capricious
questions.explain: magnanimous 意为‘宽宏大量的、气量大的’，与‘愿意承认错误并从中学习’的谦逊品质匹配；arrogant（傲慢的）、dogmatic（教条的）、capricious（反复无常的）均为负面品质，与语境相反。

questions.stem: The ______ of the ancient manuscript required months of painstaking effort by the paleographers.
opts: decipherment
obfuscation
dissemination
falsification
questions.explain: decipherment 意为‘破译、解读’，与‘古文字学家数月艰苦努力’的语境吻合；obfuscation（混淆）、dissemination（传播）、falsification（伪造）均不符合‘破译’这一核心动作。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the graduate students struggled to follow the intricate theoretical framework.
opts: esoteric
prosaic
lucid
superficial
questions.explain: 考查形容词辨析。esoteric 意为'深奥难懂的'，符合语境中研究生都难以理解的描述；prosaic 意为'平淡乏味的'；lucid 意为'清晰易懂的'；superficial 意为'肤浅的'。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's attempt to ______ the financial losses, the quarterly report revealed a devastating deficit.
opts: obfuscate
substantiate
delineate
disseminate
questions.explain: 考查动词辨析。obfuscate 意为'使模糊、混淆'，与'试图掩盖财务损失'的语境吻合；substantiate 意为'证实'；delineate 意为'描绘、阐述'；disseminate 意为'传播'。

questions.stem: The two theories are not mutually exclusive; rather, they are ______, each shedding light on different aspects of the phenomenon.
opts: antithetical
complementary
redundant
congruent
questions.explain: 考查形容词辨析。complementary 意为'互补的'，符合'相互不排斥、各自阐明不同方面'的语境；antithetical 意为'对立的'；redundant 意为'冗余的'；congruent 意为'一致的'。

questions.stem: The author's ______ style, characterized by long digressions and obscure allusions, made the novel a challenging read.
opts: pithy
discursive
terse
succinct
questions.explain: 考查形容词辨析。discursive 意为'散漫的、东拉西扯的'，与'长篇离题和晦涩典故'的描述一致；pithy/terse/succinct 均意为'简洁精练的'，与语境相反。

questions.stem: The diplomat's remarks were deliberately ______, leaving both parties uncertain about the government's true stance.
opts: unequivocal
ambiguous
candid
dogmatic
questions.explain: 考查形容词辨析。ambiguous 意为'模棱两可的'，符合'让双方都不确定政府真实立场'的语境；unequivocal 意为'明确的'；candid 意为'坦率的'；dogmatic 意为'教条的'。

questions.stem: The CEO's ______ approach to management—micromanaging every detail—ultimately demoralized the creative team.
opts: laissez-faire
pragmatic
paternalistic
delegatory
questions.explain: 考查形容词辨析。paternalistic 意为'家长式作风的'，与'事无巨细地微观管理'的描述吻合；laissez-faire 意为'自由放任的'；pragmatic 意为'务实的'；delegatory 意为'授权的'。

questions.stem: The novel's protagonist undergoes a profound ______, transforming from a naive idealist into a cynical realist.
opts: stasis
metamorphosis
regression
convergence
questions.explain: 考查名词辨析。metamorphosis 意为'质变、蜕变'，与'从天真理想主义者转变为愤世嫉俗的现实主义者'的彻底变化吻合；stasis 意为'停滞'；regression 意为'倒退'；convergence 意为'趋同'。

questions.stem: The politician's speech was filled with ______ rhetoric designed to appeal to voters' emotions rather than their reason.
opts: demagogic
didactic
sardonic
pedantic
questions.explain: 考查形容词辨析。demagogic 意为'煽动性的、蛊惑人心的'，与'诉诸情感而非理性'的语境吻合；didactic 意为'说教的'；sardonic 意为'讽刺的'；pedantic 意为'迂腐的、卖弄学问的'。

questions.stem: The evidence presented was merely ______, suggesting a correlation but failing to establish a causal relationship.
opts: conclusive
circumstantial
irrefutable
substantive
questions.explain: 考查形容词辨析。circumstantial 意为'间接的、旁证的'，与'暗示相关性但未能建立因果关系'的描述吻合；conclusive/irrefutable/substantive 均意为'决定性的、确凿的'，与语境相反。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the most attentive students found it difficult to follow the thread of his argument.
opts: lucid
abstruse
eloquent
terse
questions.explain: abstruse 意为‘深奥难懂的’，符合语境‘连最专注的学生都难以跟上论证思路’；lucid 是‘清晰的’，与句意相反；eloquent 是‘雄辩的’；terse 是‘简洁的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ apology, the board remained skeptical about his true intentions.
opts: contrite
obsequious
candid
nonchalant
questions.explain: contrite 意为‘忏悔的、悔罪的’，与‘道歉’搭配且符合‘董事会怀疑其真实意图’的语境；obsequious 是‘谄媚的’，侧重讨好而非悔过；candid 是‘坦率的’；nonchalant 是‘漠不关心的’，均不贴切。

questions.stem: The two theories are not mutually exclusive; rather, they are ______ and can be integrated into a unified framework.
opts: antithetical
congruent
disparate
redundant
questions.explain: congruent 意为‘一致的、相合的’，与‘可以整合为统一框架’呼应；antithetical 是‘对立的’；disparate 是‘迥异的’；redundant 是‘冗余的’，均不符合‘可整合’的逻辑。

questions.stem: Her ______ remarks during the negotiation only served to alienate the other party, making a compromise even more elusive.
opts: conciliatory
vitriolic
judicious
taciturn
questions.explain: vitriolic 意为‘尖刻的、辛辣的’，符合‘疏远对方、使妥协更难达成’的负面语境；conciliatory 是‘安抚的’，与结果矛盾；judicious 是‘明智的’；taciturn 是‘沉默寡言的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: The historian warned against a ______ reading of the document, urging scholars to consider the broader socio-political context.
opts: literal
nuanced
skeptical
holistic
questions.explain: literal 意为‘字面的’，与‘警告不要只做字面解读、要考虑更广的社会政治背景’完全吻合；nuanced 是‘细致入微的’；skeptical 是‘怀疑的’；holistic 是‘整体的’，均与‘警告’的逻辑不符。

questions.stem: The artist's later works are characterized by a ______ of color and form, a stark contrast to the rigid symmetry of his early period.
opts: profusion
paucity
fixation
rejection
questions.explain: profusion 意为‘大量、丰富’，与‘与早期严格的对称形成鲜明对比’一致，暗示后期作品色彩和形式丰富；paucity 是‘匮乏’，与对比逻辑相反；fixation 是‘固着’；rejection 是‘拒绝’，均不恰当。

questions.stem: The new policy is not a panacea; it is merely a ______ measure intended to buy time for more comprehensive reforms.
opts: definitive
stopgap
radical
sweeping
questions.explain: stopgap 意为‘权宜之计、临时的’，与‘不是万能药、仅为争取时间’完全对应；definitive 是‘决定性的’；radical 是‘激进的’；sweeping 是‘全面的’，均与‘buy time’的临时性矛盾。

questions.stem: His ______ memory for dates and names made him an invaluable asset to the research team.
opts: fallible
retentive
selective
fading
questions.explain: retentive 意为‘记忆力强的’，与‘成为研究团队的宝贵资产’形成因果；fallible 是‘容易出错的’；selective 是‘有选择性的’；fading 是‘衰退的’，均与‘invaluable asset’的逻辑相悖。

questions.stem: The critic's review was so ______ that it was impossible to tell whether he actually liked or loathed the film.
opts: unequivocal
ambiguous
effusive
scathing
questions.explain: ambiguous 意为‘模棱两可的’，直接对应‘无法判断他到底是喜欢还是厌恶’；unequivocal 是‘明确的’，与句意相反；effusive 是‘感情奔放的’；scathing 是‘严厉批评的’，均不能造成‘无法判断’的效果。

questions.stem: The company's ______ approach to innovation—waiting for competitors to test the market before launching its own version—has often been criticized as risk-averse.
opts: pioneering
reactive
proactive
visionary
questions.explain: reactive 意为‘反应式的、被动的’，与‘等待竞争对手测试市场后才推出自己版本’的描述完全吻合；pioneering 是‘开创性的’；proactive 是‘主动的’；visionary 是‘有远见的’，均与‘risk-averse’的批评逻辑矛盾。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the most attentive students found themselves struggling to keep up with the intricate web of theoretical concepts.
opts: esoteric
pedantic
lucid
superficial
questions.explain: esoteric 意为‘深奥难懂的’，符合语境；pedantic 是‘迂腐的、卖弄学问的’，lucid 是‘清晰的’，superficial 是‘肤浅的’，均与‘struggling to keep up’逻辑矛盾。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ remarks about the company's future, the quarterly report revealed a staggering 40% decline in revenue.
opts: sanguine
somber
equivocal
laconic
questions.explain: sanguine 意为‘乐观的’，与后半句‘decline in revenue’形成转折对比；somber 是‘阴沉的’，equivocal 是‘模棱两可的’，laconic 是‘简洁的’，均不符合转折逻辑。

questions.stem: The novelist's style is often described as ______, weaving together multiple narrative threads with an almost musical sense of rhythm and repetition.
opts: prosaic
contrapuntal
didactic
terse
questions.explain: contrapuntal 原指音乐中的‘对位法的’，引申为文学中多条线索交织的复调风格，符合‘weaving together multiple narrative threads’；prosaic 是‘平淡的’，didactic 是‘说教的’，terse 是‘简练的’。

questions.stem: The diplomat's ______ response to the journalist's provocative question deftly avoided any direct commitment while appearing perfectly cooperative.
opts: candid
obsequious
evasive
bellicose
questions.explain: evasive 意为‘回避的、推诿的’，与‘avoided any direct commitment’直接对应；candid 是‘坦率的’，obsequious 是‘谄媚的’，bellicose 是‘好斗的’。

questions.stem: The new policy is not a panacea but rather a ______ measure designed to buy time until a more comprehensive solution can be implemented.
opts: permanent
stopgap
draconian
systemic
questions.explain: stopgap 意为‘权宜之计、临时的’，与‘buy time until a more comprehensive solution’完全匹配；permanent 是‘永久的’，draconian 是‘严厉的’，systemic 是‘系统性的’。

questions.stem: His argument was so ______ that even his strongest supporters found themselves unable to identify a single coherent thesis.
opts: cogent
desultory
polemical
dogmatic
questions.explain: desultory 意为‘散漫的、无条理的’，与‘unable to identify a single coherent thesis’吻合；cogent 是‘有说服力的’，polemical 是‘争论的’，dogmatic 是‘教条的’。

questions.stem: The critic's review was ______, praising the film's cinematography while excoriating its shallow character development.
opts: ambivalent
laudatory
vitriolic
equivocal
questions.explain: ambivalent 意为‘矛盾的、好坏参半的’，与既 praise 又 excoriate 的混合态度一致；laudatory 是‘赞扬的’，vitriolic 是‘尖刻的’，equivocal 是‘模棱两可的’。

questions.stem: The CEO's ______ management style, characterized by constant meddling in operational details, demoralized the senior leadership team.
opts: hands-off
micromanaging
charismatic
visionary
questions.explain: micromanaging 意为‘微观管理的’，与‘constant meddling in operational details’直接对应；hands-off 是‘放手式的’，charismatic 是‘有魅力的’，visionary 是‘有远见的’。

questions.stem: The ancient ritual was not merely symbolic but was believed to have ______ power, capable of altering the course of natural events.
opts: nominal
talismanic
ornamental
pedagogical
questions.explain: talismanic 意为‘护身符般的、有神奇力量的’，与‘capable of altering the course of natural events’匹配；nominal 是‘名义上的’，ornamental 是‘装饰性的’，pedagogical 是‘教学法的’。

questions.stem: The defendant's testimony was so ______, shifting between three incompatible versions of events, that the jury found it completely unbelievable.
opts: consistent
contradictory
corroborative
circumstantial
questions.explain: contradictory 意为‘矛盾的、相互抵触的’，与‘shifting between three incompatible versions’吻合；consistent 是‘一致的’，corroborative 是‘佐证的’，circumstantial 是‘间接的（证据）’。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the most attentive students found themselves struggling to keep up with the intricate theoretical framework.
opts: abstruse
superficial
lucid
redundant
questions.explain: abstruse 意为‘深奥难懂的’，与后文‘struggling to keep up with intricate theoretical framework’呼应；superficial（肤浅的）、lucid（清晰的）、redundant（冗余的）均不符合语境。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ apology, the board remained unconvinced of his genuine remorse and demanded a more forthright admission of fault.
opts: candid
contrite
equivocal
eloquent
questions.explain: equivocal 意为‘模棱两可的、含糊的’，与后文‘board remained unconvinced’及‘demanded a more forthright admission’形成逻辑对比；candid（坦率的）、contrite（忏悔的）、eloquent（雄辩的）均不能解释为何董事会仍不满意。

questions.stem: The novelist's style is often described as ______, as she weaves together multiple narrative threads with effortless grace and precision.
opts: laconic
tortuous
limpid
grandiloquent
questions.explain: limpid 意为‘清晰的、流畅的’，与‘weaves together multiple narrative threads with effortless grace and precision’语义一致；laconic（简洁的但常指过于简短）、tortuous（曲折复杂的）、grandiloquent（浮夸的）均不匹配。

questions.stem: The diplomat's ______ remarks during the press conference only exacerbated the already tense relations between the two nations.
opts: judicious
conciliatory
inflammatory
diplomatic
questions.explain: inflammatory 意为‘煽动性的、激怒人的’，与‘exacerbated the already tense relations’直接对应；judicious（明智的）、conciliatory（安抚的）、diplomatic（外交的/圆滑的）均会导致关系缓和而非恶化。

questions.stem: The archaeologist's claim that the artifact was a genuine relic from the 12th dynasty was met with ______ from the academic community, as many scholars doubted its provenance.
opts: acclamation
credulity
skepticism
veneration
questions.explain: skepticism 意为‘怀疑态度’，与‘many scholars doubted its provenance’完全对应；acclamation（欢呼/称赞）、credulity（轻信）、veneration（崇敬）均与‘doubted’矛盾。

questions.stem: Her ______ nature made her an ideal candidate for the undercover assignment, as she could seamlessly adapt her demeanor to any social setting.
opts: gregarious
chameleonic
dogmatic
fastidious
questions.explain: chameleonic 意为‘变色龙般的、善于变化的’，与‘seamlessly adapt her demeanor to any social setting’直接对应；gregarious（爱社交的）、dogmatic（教条的）、fastidious（挑剔的）均不强调适应性变化。

questions.stem: The critic's review was surprisingly ______, praising the film's cinematography while also acknowledging its narrative shortcomings.
opts: vituperative
laudatory
ambivalent
pedantic
questions.explain: ambivalent 意为‘矛盾的、有矛盾情感的’，与‘praising...while also acknowledging...shortcomings’形成正反并存的语义；vituperative（辱骂的）、laudatory（赞扬的）、pedantic（迂腐的）均不能同时包含褒贬。

questions.stem: The CEO's decision to ______ the company's core values in pursuit of short-term profits was met with widespread internal dissent.
opts: uphold
espouse
jettison
exemplify
questions.explain: jettison 意为‘抛弃、丢弃’，与‘in pursuit of short-term profits’及‘widespread internal dissent’构成因果关系；uphold（维护）、espouse（支持）、exemplify（例示）均与‘dissent’逻辑矛盾。

questions.stem: The poet's use of ______ language—where the literal meaning is often the opposite of the intended one—requires careful reading to uncover the true sentiment.
opts: literal
ironic
euphonic
didactic
questions.explain: ironic 意为‘讽刺的’，定义即‘literal meaning is often the opposite of the intended one’，完全匹配；literal（字面的）、euphonic（悦耳的）、didactic（说教的）均不涉及反义表达。

questions.stem: The witness's testimony was so ______ that the jury found it impossible to determine what had actually occurred on the night of the incident.
opts: coherent
garbled
cogent
voluble
questions.explain: garbled 意为‘混乱不清的、被歪曲的’，与‘jury found it impossible to determine what had actually occurred’直接对应；coherent（连贯的）、cogent（有说服力的）、voluble（健谈的/流畅的）均不会导致无法判断事实。

questions.stem: The professor's remarks were so ______ that even his colleagues found them difficult to comprehend.
opts: esoteric
lucid
mundane
redundant
questions.explain: esoteric 意为‘深奥难懂的’，符合‘连同事都难以理解’的语境；lucid 清晰易懂，mundane 平凡，redundant 冗余，均不符合。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ efforts to revive the company, its financial situation continued to deteriorate.
opts: futile
strenuous
negligible
complacent
questions.explain: strenuous 意为‘竭尽全力的’，与‘尽管努力但情况仍恶化’的让步逻辑吻合；futile 无效的，negligible 可忽略的，complacent 自满的，均不匹配。

questions.stem: The two theories are not mutually exclusive; in fact, they are entirely ______.
opts: antagonistic
compatible
ambiguous
obsolete
questions.explain: compatible 意为‘兼容的’，与‘not mutually exclusive’逻辑一致；antagonistic 对立的，ambiguous 模糊的，obsolete 过时的，均不符。

questions.stem: Her ______ nature made her an excellent diplomat, able to navigate even the most tense negotiations.
opts: contentious
tactful
impulsive
dogmatic
questions.explain: tactful 意为‘圆滑老练的’，是优秀外交官必备特质；contentious 好争论的，impulsive 冲动的，dogmatic 教条的，均与外交官正面形象相反。

questions.stem: The author's writing style is so ______ that readers often have to reread paragraphs to grasp the intended meaning.
opts: convoluted
succinct
eloquent
pedantic
questions.explain: convoluted 意为‘复杂费解的’，导致读者需要重读；succinct 简洁的，eloquent 雄辩的，pedantic 迂腐的，均不能解释‘需要重读’的原因。

questions.stem: The new policy was implemented to ______ the growing concerns about data privacy among users.
opts: exacerbate
allay
obfuscate
scrutinize
questions.explain: allay 意为‘减轻、缓解（担忧）’，符合政策目的；exacerbate 加剧，obfuscate 使模糊，scrutinize 仔细审查，均与‘解决担忧’的语境相反。

questions.stem: His ______ attitude toward criticism made it nearly impossible for his colleagues to offer constructive feedback.
opts: receptive
defensive
indifferent
inquisitive
questions.explain: defensive 意为‘防卫的、抵触的’，导致无法接受反馈；receptive 乐于接受的，indifferent 冷漠的，inquisitive 好奇的，其中 defensive 最符合‘无法接受批评’的负面语境。

questions.stem: The archaeological find was ______ to the study of ancient civilizations, providing unprecedented insights.
opts: peripheral
instrumental
detrimental
superfluous
questions.explain: instrumental 意为‘起重要作用的’，与‘提供前所未有的洞见’呼应；peripheral 次要的，detrimental 有害的，superfluous 多余的，均与正面意义相反。

questions.stem: The manager tried to ______ the conflict between the two departments by proposing a compromise.
opts: escalate
mediate
instigate
prolong
questions.explain: mediate 意为‘调解’，符合‘通过妥协解决冲突’的语境；escalate 升级，instigate 煽动，prolong 延长，均与‘解决冲突’的目的相悖。

questions.stem: Her ______ memory for dates and names made her the go-to person for historical facts in the office.
opts: fallible
prodigious
fading
selective
questions.explain: prodigious 意为‘惊人的、巨大的’，与‘成为办公室历史事实查询对象’的正面评价一致；fallible 易错的，fading 衰退的，selective 选择性的，均不符合‘可靠记忆’的语境。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the beginners could follow it without difficulty.
opts: abstruse
lucid
ambiguous
obscure
questions.explain: lucid 意为‘清晰易懂的’，与后文‘初学者也能跟上’呼应；其他三项均含‘难懂、模糊’之意。

questions.stem: Despite the ______ evidence, the jury remained unconvinced of the defendant's guilt.
opts: circumstantial
irrefutable
tenuous
anecdotal
questions.explain: irrefutable 意为‘无可辩驳的’，与 despite 构成让步转折逻辑；其余选项均表示证据较弱或间接。

questions.stem: The diplomat's remarks were ______, carefully avoiding any direct commitment.
opts: equivocal
candid
dogmatic
emphatic
questions.explain: equivocal 意为‘模棱两可的’，与‘避免直接承诺’吻合；candid 坦率、dogmatic 武断、emphatic 强调均不符。

questions.stem: Years of ______ training finally paid off when she won the gold medal.
opts: desultory
strenuous
perfunctory
intermittent
questions.explain: strenuous 意为‘艰苦的、费力的’，与‘最终赢得金牌’的因果逻辑匹配；其余三项均含‘随意、敷衍、间断’之意。

questions.stem: The author's ______ style, filled with long digressions, made the novel hard to finish.
opts: concise
discursive
pithy
terse
questions.explain: discursive 意为‘散漫的、东拉西扯的’，与‘长篇离题’对应；concise、pithy、terse 均表示简洁。

questions.stem: His ______ attitude toward criticism made it impossible for anyone to offer him constructive feedback.
opts: receptive
compliant
defensive
docile
questions.explain: defensive 意为‘戒备的、防卫的’，与‘无法接受建设性反馈’逻辑一致；其余三项均含‘接受、顺从’之意。

questions.stem: The CEO's decision to cut funding was ______, leaving the research team with no time to prepare.
opts: judicious
premeditated
abrupt
deliberate
questions.explain: abrupt 意为‘突然的’，与‘没有时间准备’的后果吻合；judicious 明智、premeditated 预谋、deliberate 深思熟虑均不符。

questions.stem: Her ______ memory for names and faces made her an excellent networker.
opts: fallible
faulty
tenacious
capricious
questions.explain: tenacious 意为‘持久的、牢固的’，形容记忆力好；fallible 易错的、faulty 有缺陷的、capricious 反复无常的均不合语境。

questions.stem: The journalist was praised for her ______ reporting, which uncovered the truth despite intense pressure.
opts: complacent
indolent
indefatigable
superficial
questions.explain: indefatigable 意为‘不知疲倦的’，与‘顶着巨大压力揭露真相’呼应；其余三项含‘自满、懒惰、肤浅’之意。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's ______ speech, the employees remained skeptical about the proposed merger.
opts: A. fervent
B. apathetic
C. indifferent
D. nonchalant
questions.explain: fervent 意为‘热情的、热烈的’，与 despite 引导的让步逻辑相符——尽管演讲热情，员工仍持怀疑态度；其余三项均表示‘冷漠、不关心’，与句意矛盾。

questions.stem: The new policy is intended to ______ the gap between the rich and the poor in rural areas.
opts: A. widen
B. bridge
C. ignore
D. obscure
questions.explain: bridge the gap 是固定搭配，意为‘弥合差距’；widen（扩大）、ignore（忽视）、obscure（模糊）均不符合政策‘缩小差距’的意图。

questions.stem: Her ______ remarks during the debate offended many audience members who found them overly personal.
opts: A. circumspect
B. vitriolic
C. diplomatic
D. tactful
questions.explain: vitriolic 意为‘尖酸刻薄的’，与后文‘冒犯听众、过于针对个人’呼应；circumspect（谨慎的）、diplomatic（圆滑的）、tactful（得体的）均为正面词汇，与语境矛盾。

questions.stem: The ancient manuscript was so ______ that even the experts struggled to decipher its contents.
opts: A. pristine
B. illegible
C. ornate
D. verbose
questions.explain: illegible 意为‘难以辨认的’，与‘专家也难以破译’直接对应；pristine（崭新的）、ornate（装饰华丽的）、verbose（冗长的）均不涉及‘辨认困难’这一核心。

questions.stem: A good leader should be able to ______ different opinions and reach a consensus.
opts: A. suppress
B. reconcile
C. aggravate
D. disregard
questions.explain: reconcile 意为‘调和、使一致’，与‘达成共识’逻辑一致；suppress（压制）、aggravate（加剧）、disregard（忽视）均与建设性领导行为相悖。

questions.stem: The witness's testimony was ______ with the forensic evidence, casting doubt on its credibility.
opts: A. consistent
B. compatible
C. incongruent
D. harmonious
questions.explain: incongruent 意为‘不一致的’，与后文‘对其可信度产生怀疑’呼应；consistent（一致的）、compatible（兼容的）、harmonious（和谐的）均表示‘一致’，与句意相反。

questions.stem: Years of ______ training enabled the pianist to perform the most technically demanding pieces with ease.
opts: A. sporadic
B. rigorous
C. leisurely
D. superficial
questions.explain: rigorous 意为‘严格的、高强度的’，与‘能够轻松演奏技术要求极高的曲目’形成因果；sporadic（零星的）、leisurely（悠闲的）、superficial（肤浅的）均无法支撑高水平演奏的结果。

questions.stem: The government's attempt to ______ the scandal only made the media more determined to investigate.
opts: A. exacerbate
B. conceal
C. illuminate
D. rectify
questions.explain: conceal 意为‘掩盖’，与‘反而让媒体更想调查’的转折逻辑吻合；exacerbate（加剧）、illuminate（阐明）、rectify（纠正）均不符合‘试图隐藏’的语境。

questions.stem: His ______ personality made him the life of every party, but also sometimes overwhelmed more introverted friends.
opts: A. gregarious
B. reclusive
C. aloof
D. taciturn
questions.explain: gregarious 意为‘爱社交的、合群的’，与‘派对灵魂’直接对应；reclusive（隐居的）、aloof（冷漠的）、taciturn（沉默寡言的）均为内向特质，与前半句矛盾。

questions.stem: The professor's ______ remarks during the lecture left the students utterly confused, as they contradicted the textbook's clear explanation.
opts: enigmatic
lucid
pedantic
redundant
questions.explain: enigmatic 意为‘难以理解的、神秘的’，符合‘让学生困惑’的语境；lucid 意为‘清晰的’，与句意相反；pedantic 意为‘迂腐的、学究式的’，redundant 意为‘冗余的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: Despite the CEO's promise of transparency, the company's financial report was deliberately ______, making it nearly impossible for investors to assess the true risk.
opts: obfuscated
elucidated
streamlined
audited
questions.explain: obfuscated 意为‘使模糊、使困惑’，符合‘故意让报告难以理解’的语境；elucidated 意为‘阐明’，streamlined 意为‘精简的’，audited 意为‘审计过的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: The two theories appear similar on the surface, but a closer examination reveals a fundamental ______ between their core assumptions.
opts: dichotomy
synthesis
analogy
congruence
questions.explain: dichotomy 意为‘二分法、对立’，强调两者之间的根本性差异；synthesis 意为‘综合’，analogy 意为‘类比’，congruence 意为‘一致’，均与‘根本差异’的语境不符。

questions.stem: The novelist's writing style is characterized by a ______ of realism and fantasy, creating a unique literary landscape that defies easy categorization.
opts: fusion
fission
friction
fraction
questions.explain: fusion 意为‘融合’，符合‘现实主义与幻想相结合’的语境；fission 意为‘分裂’，friction 意为‘摩擦’，fraction 意为‘碎片’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: The politician's speech was filled with ______ language, carefully avoiding any direct commitment that could later be used against him.
opts: equivocal
unequivocal
eloquent
emphatic
questions.explain: equivocal 意为‘模棱两可的’，符合‘避免直接承诺’的语境；unequivocal 意为‘明确的’，与句意相反；eloquent 意为‘雄辩的’，emphatic 意为‘强调的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: Years of ______ training allowed the pianist to perform the technically demanding piece with seemingly effortless precision.
opts: arduous
cursory
sporadic
lethargic
questions.explain: arduous 意为‘艰苦的、费力的’，符合‘多年艰苦训练’的语境；cursory 意为‘粗略的’，sporadic 意为‘零星的’，lethargic 意为‘无精打采的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: The historian argued that the empire's collapse was not sudden but rather the result of a gradual ______ of its political and economic institutions.
opts: erosion
revival
consolidation
expansion
questions.explain: erosion 意为‘侵蚀、逐渐削弱’，符合‘制度逐渐崩溃’的语境；revival 意为‘复兴’，consolidation 意为‘巩固’，expansion 意为‘扩张’，均与‘collapse’的语境相反。

questions.stem: The CEO's ______ decision to invest heavily in outdated technology ultimately led to the company's decline in the competitive market.
opts: myopic
prescient
judicious
prudent
questions.explain: myopic 意为‘目光短浅的’，符合‘投资过时技术导致衰落’的语境；prescient 意为‘有先见之明的’，judicious 意为‘明智的’，prudent 意为‘谨慎的’，均为褒义词，与句意相反。

questions.stem: The witness's testimony was so ______ that the jury found it impossible to determine what had actually happened at the crime scene.
opts: incoherent
corroborated
compelling
unambiguous
questions.explain: incoherent 意为‘不连贯的、语无伦次的’，符合‘陪审团无法判断事实’的语境；corroborated 意为‘被证实的’，compelling 意为‘令人信服的’，unambiguous 意为‘明确的’，均与句意相反。

questions.stem: The artist's work has a ______ quality, blending elements from various cultural traditions into something entirely new and unexpected.
opts: eclectic
monolithic
homogeneous
dogmatic
questions.explain: eclectic 意为‘兼收并蓄的’，符合‘融合多种文化元素’的语境；monolithic 意为‘单一的、庞大的’，homogeneous 意为‘同质的’，dogmatic 意为‘教条的’，均不匹配。

questions.stem: Despite the ______ weather, the rescue team continued their search for the missing hikers.
opts: benign
inclement
temperate
element
questions.explain: inclement 意为‘恶劣的（天气）’，与 despite 让步逻辑吻合；benign/temperate/element 均指‘温和的、良好的’，不合逻辑。

questions.stem: The two theories are so ______ that even experts sometimes confuse them.
opts: disparate
analogous
divergent
obsolete
questions.explain: analogous 意为‘相似的’，导致混淆；disparate/divergent 意为‘不同的’，obsolete 意为‘过时的’，均不直接导致混淆。

questions.stem: His ______ remarks during the meeting offended several colleagues who took them personally.
opts: tactful
diplomatic
caustic
complimentary
questions.explain: caustic 意为‘尖刻的、讽刺的’，与‘冒犯同事’的后果一致；tactful/diplomatic 意为‘圆滑的’，complimentary 意为‘赞美性的’，均不会导致冒犯。

questions.stem: The new policy is designed to ______ economic growth while maintaining price stability.
opts: stifle
curb
hamper
stimulate
questions.explain: stimulate 意为‘刺激、促进’，与‘维持价格稳定’同为政策目标；stifle/curb/hamper 均含‘抑制、阻碍’之意，与政策目的相悖。

questions.stem: The witness's testimony was ______; she gave completely different accounts on two separate occasions.
opts: consistent
coherent
contradictory
conclusive
questions.explain: contradictory 意为‘相互矛盾的’，与‘两次说法完全不同’对应；consistent/coherent 意为‘一致的’，conclusive 意为‘决定性的’，均不符。

questions.stem: The artist's early works are largely ______, showing little originality or creativity.
opts: innovative
derivative
pioneering
seminal
questions.explain: derivative 意为‘缺乏独创性的、模仿的’，与‘缺乏原创性’对应；innovative/pioneering/seminal 均含‘创新、开创’之意，与句意相反。

questions.stem: The manager tried to ______ the tension between the two departments by organizing a joint workshop.
opts: exacerbate
alleviate
aggravate
intensify
questions.explain: alleviate 意为‘缓解、减轻’，与‘组织联合研讨会’的目的吻合；exacerbate/aggravate/intensify 均意为‘加剧’，与目的相反。

questions.stem: Her ______ approach to problem-solving often leads to creative but impractical solutions.
opts: pragmatic
conventional
whimsical
methodical
questions.explain: whimsical 意为‘异想天开的、古怪的’，与‘有创意但不切实际’对应；pragmatic/conventional/methodical 均含‘务实、常规、有条理’之意，与‘不切实际’矛盾。

questions.stem: The company's ______ financial situation forced it to declare bankruptcy.
opts: robust
precarious
stable
prosperous
questions.explain: precarious 意为‘不稳定的、危险的’，与‘被迫宣布破产’的因果逻辑一致；robust/stable/prosperous 均意为‘稳健、繁荣’，与破产矛盾。

questions.stem: The professor's lecture was so ______ that even the beginners could follow his complex theories without difficulty.
opts: esoteric
lucid
ambiguous
pedantic
questions.explain: lucid 意为‘清晰易懂的’，符合‘初学者也能听懂复杂理论’的语境；esoteric 深奥难懂的、ambiguous 模棱两可的、pedantic 迂腐学究气的，均与句意相反。

questions.stem: Despite the company's ______ efforts to improve public image, the scandal continued to damage its reputation.
opts: vigorous
futile
covert
sporadic
questions.explain: futile 意为‘徒劳的、无效的’，与 despite 引导的让步转折逻辑吻合——努力无效，丑闻继续损害声誉；vigorous 有力的、covert 隐蔽的、sporadic 零星的，均无法体现‘努力但无果’的转折关系。

questions.stem: The two political systems are so fundamentally different that any attempt at ______ seems doomed to failure.
opts: convergence
divergence
subsistence
resilience
questions.explain: convergence 意为‘趋同、汇合’，句意是‘两种制度根本不同，试图使其趋同注定失败’；divergence 分歧、subsistence 生存、resilience 韧性，均不符合逻辑。

questions.stem: Her ______ remarks during the debate alienated many undecided voters who had previously been sympathetic to her cause.
opts: conciliatory
inflammatory
diplomatic
judicious
questions.explain: inflammatory 意为‘煽动性的、使人激愤的’，导致‘疏远中间选民’的结果；conciliatory 安抚的、diplomatic 圆滑的、judicious 明智的，均不会造成 alienated 的负面后果。

questions.stem: The historian warned against drawing ______ conclusions from incomplete archaeological evidence.
opts: tentative
hasty
meticulous
plausible
questions.explain: hasty 意为‘仓促的、草率的’，与‘从不完整证据中得出结论’的警告语境匹配；tentative 试探性的（中性偏谨慎）、meticulous 一丝不苟的（褒义）、plausible 看似合理的（中性），均不符合‘警告’的语气。

questions.stem: The new policy is not a panacea but merely a ______ measure to alleviate the most pressing symptoms of the economic crisis.
opts: palliative
radical
comprehensive
permanent
questions.explain: palliative 意为‘治标不治本的、缓解性的’，与‘不是万能药，只是缓解最紧迫症状’的语境完全吻合；radical 根本的、comprehensive 全面的、permanent 永久的，均与 merely 和 alleviate symptoms 的语义矛盾。

questions.stem: The author's writing style is characterized by a ______ of formal diction and colloquial expressions, creating a unique narrative voice.
opts: juxtaposition
disparity
uniformity
scarcity
questions.explain: juxtaposition 意为‘并置、并列’，指正式用语与口语表达的并列使用，形成独特风格；disparity 差异、uniformity 一致、scarcity 缺乏，均无法描述‘两者同时使用’的创作手法。

questions.stem: The CEO's decision to ______ the failing division surprised no one, as it had been operating at a loss for five consecutive years.
opts: consolidate
dissolve
subsidize
revitalize
questions.explain: dissolve 意为‘解散、终止’，与‘连续五年亏损’的语境一致——解散亏损部门符合逻辑；consolidate 巩固、subsidize 补贴、revitalize 振兴，均与‘operating at a loss for five years’的负面事实相悖。

questions.stem: The witness's testimony was so ______ that the jury found it impossible to determine what had actually happened.
opts: coherent
contradictory
corroborative
conclusive
questions.explain: contradictory 意为‘相互矛盾的’，导致‘陪审团无法判断真相’的结果；coherent 连贯的、corroborative 佐证的、conclusive 决定性的，均不会造成无法判断的局面。

questions.stem: While the two theories share some superficial similarities, they ______ on the fundamental question of human agency.
opts: converge
diverge
coincide
coalesce
questions.explain: diverge 意为‘分歧、相异’，与 while 引导的让步转折（表面相似但根本分歧）逻辑吻合；converge 趋同、coincide 一致、coalesce 合并，均与‘fundamental question 上不同’的语义相反。

questions.stem: Despite the company's financial troubles, the CEO remained ______, assuring everyone that a turnaround was imminent.
opts: skeptical
pessimistic
complacent
sanguine
questions.explain: sanguine 意为'乐观的、充满信心的'，与'尽管财务困难仍保证好转'的语境吻合；skeptical/pessimistic 表怀疑或悲观，complacent 表自满，均不合逻辑。

questions.stem: The two theories are not mutually exclusive; in fact, they are entirely ______, each addressing a different aspect of the phenomenon.
opts: compatible
contradictory
comparable
competitive
questions.explain: compatible 意为'兼容的、可共存的'，与'并非互斥'及'各自解释不同方面'呼应；contradictory 表矛盾，comparable 表可比，competitive 表竞争，均不贴切。

questions.stem: The journalist was praised for her ______ reporting, which presented all sides of the controversy without bias.
opts: partial
impartial
partisan
prejudiced
questions.explain: impartial 意为'公正的、不偏不倚的'，与'呈现所有方面、无偏见'直接对应；partial/partisan/prejudiced 均含'偏袒、偏见'之意，与语境相反。

questions.stem: Years of ______ practice allowed the pianist to perform the technically demanding piece with effortless grace.
opts: diligent
negligent
indolent
sporadic
