questions.stem: In the sentence 'She was filled with a sense of achievement,' the phrase 'a sense of achievement' should be translated into Chinese as ______.
opts: 成就感
成就的感觉
一种成就的感觉
成就意识
questions.explain: ‘a sense of achievement’是固定搭配，汉语对应‘成就感’，简洁自然，无需逐字直译为‘成就的感觉’。

questions.stem: The English idiom 'kill two birds with one stone' is best translated into Chinese as ______.
opts: 一石二鸟
一箭双雕
一举两得
两全其美
questions.explain: 英译汉时习惯用汉语中功能对等的成语，‘kill two birds with one stone’对应汉语成语‘一箭双雕’，比直译‘一石二鸟’更符合汉语表达习惯。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'The book is well worth reading,' the phrase 'well worth reading' should be translated as ______.
opts: 很值得读
非常值得被读
很值得被阅读
值得好好读
questions.explain: ‘well worth reading’中‘well’修饰‘worth’表示程度，汉语习惯说‘很值得读’，无需将‘reading’译为被动‘被读’。

questions.stem: The English sentence 'It is no use crying over spilt milk' should be translated into Chinese as ______.
opts: 不要为打翻的牛奶哭泣
覆水难收
木已成舟
后悔无益
questions.explain: 英译汉时意译优于直译，‘It is no use crying over spilt milk’对应汉语谚语‘覆水难收’，比直译‘不要为打翻的牛奶哭泣’更地道。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'He is the last person I want to see,' the word 'last' should be translated as ______.
opts: 最后的
最不愿意的
上一个
最近的
questions.explain: ‘the last person (that) I want to see’中‘last’表示‘最不可能的/最不愿意的’，而非字面‘最后的’，应译为‘最不愿意看到的人’。

questions.stem: In the sentence "It is essential that the project be completed by Friday," the underlined part "be completed" should be translated into Chinese as:
opts: 被完成
完成
应该被完成
正在完成
questions.explain: 考点：虚拟语气中动词原形表“应该做”，英译汉时省略“被”字，直接译为主动形式“完成”更符合中文习惯。

questions.stem: The phrase "a matter of great importance" is best translated into Chinese as:
opts: 一件重要的大事
一件非常重要的事情
一个重大的问题
一个重要的物质
questions.explain: 考点：名词短语的意译，"matter of great importance" 译为“非常重要的事情”，避免字字对译。

questions.stem: In "He is known to have written many novels," the infinitive "to have written" should be translated as:
opts: 写了很多小说
已经写了很多小说
正在写很多小说
被写了很多小说
questions.explain: 考点：不定式完成体表示动作发生在谓语动作之前，英译汉需加“已经”体现时态。

questions.stem: The English sentence "Not until the teacher came in did the students stop talking" should be translated into Chinese as:
opts: 直到老师进来学生们才停止说话
直到老师进来学生们没有停止说话
老师进来前学生们停止了说话
老师一进来学生们就停止了说话
questions.explain: 考点："not until"倒装结构应译为“直到……才……”，保持汉语的否定前置逻辑。

questions.stem: The word "unforgettable" in "an unforgettable experience" is best rendered in Chinese as:
opts: 不可忘记的
难忘的
不能忘记的
忘不掉的
questions.explain: 考点：英语否定前缀 un- 在汉语中常用四字格或双音节词“难忘的”表达，更符合汉语习惯。

questions.stem: In "She was denied the opportunity to study abroad," the verb "denied" should be translated as:
opts: 被拒绝
被剥夺了
否认了
拒绝了
questions.explain: 考点："deny"在“拒绝给予”义项下，英译汉宜用“被剥夺了”以准确传达被动含义及损失意味。

questions.stem: The sentence "It is no use crying over spilt milk" is idiomatically translated into Chinese as:
opts: 不要为洒了的牛奶哭泣
覆水难收
牛奶洒了哭也没用
不要哭哭啼啼
questions.explain: 考点：英语谚语应译为汉语对应习语“覆水难收”，而非字面直译，体现英译汉的归化策略。

questions.stem: In "The book is worth reading twice," the structure "worth reading" should be translated as:
opts: 值得被读
值得读
值得读两次
值得被阅读
questions.explain: 考点："worth doing" 主动形式表被动意义，英译汉时直接译为“值得读”即可，无需加“被”。

questions.stem: The phrase "on the contrary" in "He is not lazy; on the contrary, he is very hardworking" is best translated as:
opts: 相反
正相反
反之
恰恰相反
questions.explain: 考点："on the contrary" 在强调对比时，汉语常用“恰恰相反”加强语气，比“相反”更贴切。

questions.stem: In "The problem remains to be solved," the passive infinitive "to be solved" should be translated as:
opts: 被解决
来解决
有待解决
被解决了
questions.explain: 考点："remain to be done" 结构表示“有待……”，英译汉时不宜直译“被解决”，而应译为“有待解决”更自然。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'It is essential that he finish the work on time,' the correct Chinese translation of 'essential' is ______.
opts: A. 可能的
B. 必要的
C. 有趣的
D. 困难的
questions.explain: 考点：essential 在英译汉中常译为'必要的'，表示'必不可少'，而非'可能的'(possible)或'有趣的'(interesting)。

questions.stem: The phrase 'by no means' in 'He is by no means a fool' should be translated into Chinese as ______.
opts: A. 无论如何
B. 绝不
C. 通过某种方式
D. 几乎
questions.explain: 考点：'by no means'是固定短语，意为'绝不'，表示强烈否定，不能按字面拆译为'通过某种方式'。

questions.stem: In English-Chinese translation, the word 'literally' in 'He literally jumped for joy' is best rendered as ______.
opts: A. 字面上地
B. 确实地/简直
C. 文学地
D. 缓慢地
questions.explain: 考点：'literally'在口语中常作强调语，译为'确实地/简直'，而非机械地译成'字面上地'。

questions.stem: The English sentence 'She is too young to go to school' should be translated into Chinese as ______.
opts: A. 她太小了，不能去上学
B. 她太年轻了，所以去上学
C. 她虽然小，但可以去上学
D. 她年龄大，可以去上学
questions.explain: 考点：'too...to...'结构表示'太……而不能……'，英译汉时需译出否定含义。

questions.stem: When translating 'He has been working here since 2010' into Chinese, the correct tense expression is ______.
opts: A. 他2010年在这里工作
B. 他自2010年以来一直在这里工作
C. 他曾在2010年在这里工作
D. 他将在2010年在这里工作
questions.explain: 考点：现在完成进行时'has been working'表示从过去持续到现在的动作，英译汉需用'自……以来一直'体现时态。

questions.stem: The idiom 'kill two birds with one stone' in English-Chinese translation is best rendered as ______.
opts: A. 一石二鸟
B. 一箭双雕
C. 杀鸡取卵
D. 一举两得
questions.explain: 考点：英译汉时习语翻译应遵循汉语习惯表达，'kill two birds with one stone'对应汉语成语'一箭双雕'，而非直译'一石二鸟'（虽可理解但非地道成语）。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'Not until he arrived did we start the meeting,' the correct Chinese translation is ______.
opts: A. 直到他到达我们才开始会议
B. 直到他到达我们才没有开始会议
C. 他到达后我们还没有开始会议
D. 他到达之前我们就开始了会议
questions.explain: 考点：'Not until...did...'倒装结构英译汉时需还原为'直到……才……'的语序，表示'直到他到达我们才开始'。

questions.stem: The word 'respectively' in 'Tom and Jerry scored 80 and 90, respectively' should be translated as ______.
opts: A. 分别地
B. 尊敬地
C. 重复地
D. 相应地
questions.explain: 考点：'respectively'在列举对应关系时译为'分别地'，表示前后顺序对应，不可误译为'尊敬地'(respectfully)。

questions.stem: When translating 'I would rather stay than go' into Chinese, the correct version is ______.
opts: A. 我宁愿留下也不愿走
B. 我宁愿走也不愿留下
C. 我既想留下又想走
D. 我既不留下也不走
questions.explain: 考点：'would rather...than...'结构表示'宁愿……也不愿……'，英译汉需准确体现取舍关系。

questions.stem: The English phrase 'as well as' in 'He speaks French as well as English' should be translated as ______.
opts: A. 和……一样好
B. 以及/和
C. 不如
D. 除了
questions.explain: 考点：'as well as'在此句中作并列连词，意为'以及/和'，连接两个并列成分，而非比较级'和……一样好'。

questions.stem: 在英译汉中，将 "He is an apple of his father's eye" 译为「他是他父亲的掌上明珠」，主要运用了哪种翻译技巧？
opts: 直译法
意译法
增译法
省译法
questions.explain: 考点：翻译技巧辨析。「apple of one's eye」若直译为「眼中的苹果」不符合中文习惯，意译为「掌上明珠」才能准确传达原意。

questions.stem: 将 "It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife." 译为「凡是有钱的单身汉，总想娶位太太，这已经成了一条举世公认的真理。」，其中将长句拆分为短句，属于哪种翻译方法？
opts: 顺译法
逆译法
分译法
合译法
questions.explain: 考点：长句翻译策略。原文为复合长句，译文拆成三个短句，符合汉语多用短句的特点，属于分译法。

questions.stem: 将 "The importance of reading cannot be overemphasized." 译为「阅读的重要性怎么强调也不为过」，这里对 "cannot be overemphasized" 的处理采用了哪种译法？
opts: 正说反译
反说正译
增词译
省略译
questions.explain: 考点：正反译法。英文用否定式 cannot be overemphasized，中文用肯定式「怎么强调也不为过」，是典型的反说正译。

questions.stem: 将 "He is a walking dictionary." 译为「他是一本活字典」，其中 "walking" 译为「活」，运用了哪种翻译技巧？
opts: 词义引申
词性转换
增词
省词
questions.explain: 考点：词义引申。walking 本义「行走的」，在此引申为「活的」，属于根据语境进行的词义引申。

questions.stem: 将 "I am not so foolish as to believe that." 译为「我还不至于蠢到相信那件事。」，译文将 "not so...as to" 结构转换为汉语的「还不至于……」，这属于哪种翻译技巧？
opts: 正反译
词性转换
句式转换
增译
questions.explain: 考点：句式转换。英语的否定比较结构转换为汉语的否定程度句式，属于句式层面的转换。

questions.stem: 将 "She sings as well as a professional singer." 译为「她唱得和专业歌手一样好。」，其中 "as well as" 结构在翻译时采用了哪种方法？
opts: 直译
意译
省译
增译
questions.explain: 考点：直译与意译选择。as well as 结构在汉语中有对应表达「和……一样好」，采用直译即可准确传达。

questions.stem: 将 "The government is trying to get the economy back on track." 译为「政府正努力使经济重回正轨。」，其中 "back on track" 译为「重回正轨」属于哪种翻译技巧？
opts: 直译
意译
词性转换
增词
questions.explain: 考点：直译的应用。back on track 在汉语中有对应的比喻「重回正轨」，直译既保留形象又自然通顺。

questions.stem: 将 "He is too young to understand this." 译为「他太年轻，理解不了这个。」，译文将 "too...to" 结构拆分为两个短句，主要运用了哪种翻译技巧？
opts: 分译法
合译法
顺译法
逆译法
questions.explain: 考点：分译法。英语 too...to 结构在汉语中通常拆分为「太……，不能……」两个分句，属于分译。

questions.stem: 将 "This is a matter of life and death." 译为「这是生死攸关的事。」，其中 "life and death" 译为「生死」而非「生命和死亡」，运用了哪种翻译技巧？
opts: 省译法
增译法
词性转换
语序调整
questions.explain: 考点：省译法。life and death 中的 and 在汉语中省略不译，更符合汉语四字格表达习惯。

questions.stem: 将 "He was so tired that he could not go any further." 译为「他累得再也走不动了。」，译文将 "so...that" 结构转换为汉语的「……得……」结构，属于哪种翻译技巧？
opts: 句式转换
词性转换
增译
省译
questions.explain: 考点：句式转换。英语结果状语从句 so...that 转换为汉语的「得」字补语结构，是典型的句式转换。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the author's primary purpose in discussing the 'digital divide' is to ________.
opts: highlight the technological gap between developed and developing nations
criticize the over-reliance on digital tools in modern education
advocate for equal access to information technology worldwide
explain how digital literacy affects economic mobility
questions.explain: 主旨题：作者讨论‘数字鸿沟’的核心目的是呼吁全球范围内信息技术的平等获取，而非单纯描述差距或批评依赖。

questions.stem: The word 'ameliorate' in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ________.
opts: worsen
improve
ignore
measure
questions.explain: 词汇推断题：根据上下文语境，ameliorate 表示‘改善、改进’，与 improve 同义。

questions.stem: Which of the following best summarizes the main argument of the passage?
opts: Economic growth is the sole determinant of a nation's educational success.
Cultural factors play a negligible role in shaping reading habits.
Socioeconomic status and parental involvement jointly influence children's literacy development.
Government funding alone can bridge the achievement gap in reading.
questions.explain: 主旨归纳题：文章核心论点是社会经济地位与家长参与共同影响儿童读写能力发展，而非单一因素决定。

questions.stem: The author mentions 'the Hawthorne effect' in paragraph 2 primarily to ________.
opts: illustrate a common bias in observational studies
support the validity of the experimental results
introduce a psychological theory unrelated to the topic
question the reliability of self-reported data
questions.explain: 写作目的题：提及‘霍桑效应’是为了说明观察性研究中常见的偏差，提醒读者注意研究方法的局限性。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the researchers' findings challenge the conventional view that ________.
opts: early reading intervention is ineffective
vocabulary size is the best predictor of reading comprehension
phonological awareness develops naturally without instruction
bilingual education hinders academic performance
questions.explain: 推理题：研究结果挑战了‘词汇量是阅读理解最佳预测指标’的传统观点，暗示其他因素（如背景知识）同样重要。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the proposed policy can best be described as ________.
opts: strongly supportive
cautiously optimistic
deeply skeptical
completely neutral
questions.explain: 态度题：作者对提议的政策持‘谨慎乐观’态度，既看到潜在好处，也指出实施中的挑战。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true according to the passage?
opts: All participants in the study were native English speakers.
The control group showed no improvement in reading scores.
The intervention program lasted for exactly six months.
The results were statistically significant at the 0.05 level.
questions.explain: 细节判断题：根据文章最后一段，研究结果在0.05水平上具有统计显著性，其他选项与原文信息不符。

questions.stem: The phrase 'a double-edged sword' in paragraph 4 is used to convey that ________.
opts: the technology has both benefits and drawbacks
the policy requires approval from two authorities
the argument has two equally valid sides
the tool can cut in two directions simultaneously
questions.explain: 修辞理解题：‘双刃剑’比喻该技术同时具有好处和坏处，需要辩证看待。

questions.stem: The passage suggests that one limitation of the study is that ________.
opts: the sample size was too small to draw meaningful conclusions
the participants were not randomly assigned to groups
the duration of the experiment was too short
the researchers failed to control for socioeconomic variables
questions.explain: 细节推断题：文章暗示研究的局限性在于参与者未被随机分组，可能引入选择偏差。

questions.stem: What is the most likely reason the author cites the example of Finland in paragraph 5?
opts: To demonstrate that high reading scores can be achieved without standardized testing.
To argue that Finland's education system is superior to all others.
To provide a counterexample to the claim that more homework leads to better outcomes.
To illustrate the impact of teacher autonomy on student performance.
questions.explain: 例证题：引用芬兰的例子是为了说明无需依赖标准化测试也能取得高阅读成绩，支持作者对过度测试的批评。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the author's primary purpose in discussing the decline of bee populations is to
opts: highlight the economic consequences of agricultural collapse
advocate for stricter pesticide regulations worldwide
illustrate the interconnectedness of ecosystems and human activity
criticize the lack of scientific funding for entomology
questions.explain: 主旨题：作者通过蜜蜂数量下降这一现象，旨在说明生态系统与人类活动之间的相互依存关系，而非单纯讨论经济或政策层面。

questions.stem: The word 'ameliorate' in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
opts: exacerbate
mitigate
quantify
overlook
questions.explain: 词汇推断题：ameliorate 意为‘改善、减轻’，在上下文中与 mitigate（缓解）同义，而 exacerbate（加剧）是反义干扰。

questions.stem: The author mentions 'the Hawthorne effect' in paragraph 2 primarily to
opts: introduce a psychological concept unrelated to the main argument
provide a historical precedent for observational bias in research
challenge the validity of the study's experimental design
suggest that human subjects alter behavior when monitored
questions.explain: 例证功能题：作者引用霍桑效应是为了说明受试者在被观察时会改变行为，从而支持文中关于实验偏差的论点。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the researchers' initial hypothesis was
opts: confirmed by subsequent longitudinal data
partially supported but required further qualification
completely refuted by unexpected findings
irrelevant to the final conclusion drawn
questions.explain: 推断题：根据原文‘while the core assumption held, the data revealed nuances’可推断，初始假设得到部分支持但需要进一步限定，选项 B 最准确。

questions.stem: The tone of the passage can best be described as
opts: enthusiastic and celebratory
skeptical and dismissive
objective and analytical
alarmed and urgent
questions.explain: 语气态度题：学术阅读理解文章通常保持客观分析的语气，选项 C 符合学术写作的典型特征，其他选项带有过强的情感色彩。

questions.stem: According to the passage, one major limitation of the previous studies on this topic is that they
opts: relied exclusively on self-reported data
failed to account for socioeconomic variables
used a sample size too small to be statistically significant
ignored the role of cultural differences in perception
questions.explain: 细节定位题：原文明确指出 prior research overlooked socioeconomic factors，选项 B 是对该局限性的准确转述。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the proposed policy reform can be characterized as
opts: strong endorsement with minor reservations
complete opposition on ideological grounds
neutral detachment without any judgment
qualified support contingent on further evidence
questions.explain: 态度推断题：作者对政策改革持‘有条件支持’态度，即认可其方向但强调需要更多证据，选项 D 准确反映了这种审慎立场。

questions.stem: Which sentence from the passage best illustrates the concept of 'cognitive dissonance' as described in the text?
opts: 'Participants reported high satisfaction despite objective measures of failure.'
'The experimental group outperformed the control group by a significant margin.'
'Researchers noted a consistent pattern of behavior across all age groups.'
'The data were collected over a period of five consecutive years.'
questions.explain: 例证匹配题：认知失调指态度与行为不一致，选项 A 中‘尽管客观失败但报告高满意度’正是该概念的典型表现。

questions.stem: The passage implies that the main reason for the discrepancy between the two sets of findings is
opts: differences in the demographic composition of the samples
the use of outdated measurement instruments in the earlier study
a fundamental flaw in the theoretical framework of both studies
the varying definitions of the key terms employed by each research team
questions.explain: 因果推断题：原文暗示两组研究结果差异的根本原因在于对关键术语的定义不同，选项 D 准确捕捉了这一隐含逻辑关系。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author mentions 'the digital divide' primarily to illustrate that ________.
opts: A. technology has bridged the gap between rich and poor
B. unequal access to information remains a serious social issue
C. internet usage has declined in developing countries
D. digital devices are no longer affordable for most people
questions.explain: 考点：理解文中举例/引用的目的。作者提及‘数字鸿沟’是为了说明信息获取不平等仍是一个严峻的社会问题，而非技术已弥合差距。

questions.stem: According to the text, the phrase 'cognitive load' refers to ________.
opts: A. the total amount of mental effort being used in working memory
B. the physical weight of electronic devices on students
C. the number of tasks a person can complete in one hour
D. the emotional stress caused by peer competition
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文猜测词义。'cognitive load'在学术语境中指工作记忆中的心理努力总量，与物理重量或任务数量无关。

questions.stem: Which of the following best summarizes the main argument of the third paragraph?
opts: A. Online learning platforms have completely replaced traditional classrooms.
B. The effectiveness of e-learning depends heavily on learners' self-discipline.
C. Teachers are no longer necessary in the digital education era.
D. All students prefer digital textbooks over printed ones.
questions.explain: 考点：段落主旨归纳。第三段的核心论点是线上学习的效果在很大程度上取决于学习者的自律性，而非完全取代传统课堂或否定教师作用。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the 'flipped classroom' model can best be described as ________.
opts: A. strongly opposed
B. cautiously supportive
C. completely indifferent
D. highly skeptical
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者态度。文中作者在肯定翻转课堂优势的同时也指出了其潜在挑战，因此态度是‘谨慎支持’而非完全反对或漠不关心。

questions.stem: In the context of the passage, 'scaffolding' in education refers to ________.
opts: A. temporary support provided to help students achieve higher understanding
B. a physical structure built in school playgrounds
C. the grading system used to rank student performance
D. a method of punishing students for incomplete homework
questions.explain: 考点：教育类术语理解。'scaffolding'（支架式教学）指教师提供的临时性支持，帮助学生达到更高层次的理解，与物理建筑或惩罚无关。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the role of intrinsic motivation from the passage?
opts: A. It is less important than external rewards in academic success.
B. It plays a crucial part in sustaining long-term learning engagement.
C. It can be easily generated by increasing homework assignments.
D. It has no effect on students' performance in standardized tests.
questions.explain: 考点：推理判断。文中暗示内在动机在维持长期学习投入方面起着关键作用，比外部奖励更重要，且不能通过简单增加作业来激发。

questions.stem: The author uses the example of 'Project-Based Learning' to demonstrate that ________.
opts: A. traditional lectures are more effective than hands-on activities
B. students learn better when they apply knowledge to real-world problems
C. project-based approaches require no teacher guidance at all
D. all schools have successfully adopted this teaching method
questions.explain: 考点：例证作用分析。作者引用项目式学习的例子是为了证明当学生将知识应用于真实问题时学习效果更好，而非否定传统教学或声称无需教师指导。

questions.stem: According to the passage, one major challenge of personalized learning is ________.
opts: A. the lack of sufficient technological infrastructure in schools
B. the difficulty of balancing individual needs with curriculum standards
C. the unwillingness of students to use digital devices
D. the high cost of hiring more teachers for every student
questions.explain: 考点：细节定位。文中指出个性化学习的主要挑战在于平衡个体需求与课程标准的统一要求，而非单纯的技术或成本问题。

questions.stem: The word 'pedagogy' in the last paragraph most probably means ________.
opts: A. the study of children's diseases
B. the method and practice of teaching
C. the design of school buildings
D. the history of educational policies
questions.explain: 考点：根据语境推测词义。'pedagogy'（教学法）指教学的方法与实践，与儿童疾病、建筑设计或政策历史无关。

questions.stem: Which statement would the author most likely agree with regarding the future of education?
opts: A. Technology will completely replace human teachers within a decade.
B. A blended approach combining digital tools and human instruction is most promising.
C. Traditional schooling will disappear entirely by 2050.
D. Online education has proven to be a total failure.
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者观点。从全文基调看，作者最可能赞同的是‘数字工具与人工教学相结合的混合模式最有前景’，而非极端地完全取代或全盘否定。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author mentions "the digital divide" primarily to illustrate that ______.
opts: A. technological progress has widened the gap between rich and poor
B. internet access alone cannot guarantee social equality
C. developing countries are catching up in technology adoption
D. the gap is primarily caused by lack of infrastructure
questions.explain: 考查论点与论据关系——作者提及‘数字鸿沟’是为了支撑‘仅靠互联网接入无法保证社会公平’这一核心论点，而非单纯描述技术差距本身。

questions.stem: The phrase "a double-edged sword" in paragraph 3 is used to suggest that the phenomenon ______.
opts: A. has both positive and negative consequences
B. is sharp enough to cut through barriers
C. can only be wielded by experts
D. requires careful handling to avoid harm
questions.explain: 考查修辞理解——‘双刃剑’比喻同一事物兼具利弊两面，正确项直接对应这一比喻的核心含义。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the proposed policy can best be described as ______.
opts: A. strongly supportive
B. cautiously optimistic
C. deeply skeptical
D. completely neutral
questions.explain: 考查态度推断——文中通过‘however’‘unlikely to succeed’等否定性措辞表明作者对政策持深度怀疑态度。

questions.stem: What does the word "paradigm" in line 15 most probably mean?
opts: A. a typical example or pattern
B. a mathematical formula
C. a financial model
D. a legal precedent
questions.explain: 考查词义猜测——根据上下文‘shift in paradigm’及学术语境，paradigm指‘范式、典型模式’，而非数学或法律术语。

questions.stem: The author cites the study by Smith et al. (2021) in order to ______.
opts: A. challenge a widely accepted theory
B. provide empirical evidence for the previous claim
C. introduce a completely new perspective
D. summarize the current state of research
questions.explain: 考查论据功能——引用研究数据通常是为了为前文论点提供实证支撑，而非挑战或引入全新视角。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from paragraph 2 that traditional methods of assessment ______.
opts: A. are still widely used despite their flaws
B. have been completely replaced by new approaches
C. are more reliable than modern alternatives
D. focus exclusively on quantitative metrics
questions.explain: 考查推理判断——从‘although criticized, remain prevalent’可推断传统方法虽有缺陷但仍被广泛使用，其他选项缺乏文本依据。

questions.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to ______.
opts: A. advocate for a specific policy change
B. analyze the causes of a social phenomenon
C. compare two competing theoretical frameworks
D. describe a historical event in detail
questions.explain: 考查写作目的——全文围绕某一社会现象的成因展开分析，而非倡导政策、比较理论或描述历史事件。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT a factor contributing to the decline in biodiversity?
opts: A. habitat destruction
B. climate change
C. international conservation agreements
D. invasive species
questions.explain: 考查细节排除——国际保护协议旨在减缓而非导致生物多样性下降，其他三项均为文中明确指出的致因因素。

questions.stem: The author's use of rhetorical questions in the final paragraph serves to ______.
opts: A. express uncertainty about the conclusion
B. engage the reader and provoke critical thinking
C. summarize the main points of the argument
D. introduce a counterargument for refutation
questions.explain: 考查修辞功能——反问句在文末通常用于引发读者思考、增强说服力，而非表达不确定或总结观点。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author's use of the phrase 'a double-edged sword' primarily serves to ______.
opts: suggest that the phenomenon has both positive and negative consequences
indicate that the weapon described is extremely dangerous
emphasize that the outcome is unpredictable and chaotic
imply that the argument is logically contradictory
questions.explain: 考点：修辞理解（rhetorical device）。'双刃剑'是常见比喻，核心功能是表达某事物兼具利弊两面，而非字面危险或逻辑矛盾。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the structure of the passage?
opts: A problem is presented, followed by several proposed solutions and a final evaluation.
A historical overview is given, then a current trend is analyzed with supporting data.
A general claim is made, then counterarguments are listed and each is refuted.
A phenomenon is introduced, its causes are examined, and its implications are discussed.
questions.explain: 考点：篇章结构分析（text structure）。典型学术文章结构为'现象—原因—影响'；选项A为问题-解决模式，B为时间顺序，C为立论-驳论，均需根据实际段落判断。

questions.stem: The author mentions 'the Hawthorne effect' in paragraph 2 most likely to ______.
opts: introduce a new psychological theory unrelated to the main argument
provide a historical example that supports the preceding claim
criticize a famous experiment for its methodological flaws
contrast the findings of two different research traditions
questions.explain: 考点：例证功能判断（example function）。引用经典研究通常是为了支撑前文观点；干扰项常设置为'无关引入'或'批评'，需结合上下文论证方向判断。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the primary reason for the decline in biodiversity is ______.
opts: natural evolutionary processes that eliminate weaker species
human-induced habitat destruction and climate change
the overpopulation of a single dominant predator species
a lack of international cooperation on conservation policies
questions.explain: 考点：细节定位与因果识别（detail & cause-effect）。原文明确将生物多样性下降归因于人类活动导致的栖息地破坏和气候变化；其余选项虽看似合理但非原文直接陈述的主因。

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the last paragraph about the author's attitude toward technological innovation?
opts: It is unreservedly welcomed as the solution to all social problems.
It is viewed with cautious optimism, provided ethical guidelines are followed.
It is dismissed as a superficial trend that distracts from real issues.
It is considered irrelevant to the central argument of the passage.
questions.explain: 考点：推理判断（inference）。作者态度题需从末段措辞中推断，'cautious optimism'（谨慎乐观）是进阶阅读中常见的复杂态度；绝对化选项（如' unreservedly welcomed'）通常为干扰。

questions.stem: The phrase 'beg the question' in paragraph 4 is used to indicate that the argument ______.
opts: raises an interesting point worth further investigation
assumes the truth of the very conclusion it is trying to prove
challenges the reader to think more deeply about the issue
fails to provide any evidence for its central claim
questions.explain: 考点：逻辑谬误识别（logical fallacy）。'beg the question'是逻辑学术语，意为'循环论证'，即把待证明的结论当作前提；非字面'提出问题'，这是常见误解干扰。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements best summarizes the main idea of the passage?
opts: Urbanization inevitably leads to the decline of traditional cultural practices.
The relationship between urbanization and cultural preservation is complex and multifaceted.
Governments should prioritize economic development over cultural heritage protection.
Modern technology can fully replicate and replace traditional cultural experiences.
questions.explain: 考点：主旨归纳（main idea）。正确主旨应体现原文的平衡、复杂立场；绝对化或片面选项（如'inevitably leads to'、'should prioritize'、'fully replicate'）是典型干扰。

questions.stem: The author's argument in the third paragraph would be most weakened if it were true that ______.
opts: the data cited were collected from a single, unrepresentative sample
the opposing viewpoint was not given adequate consideration
the conclusion contradicts a widely accepted scientific theory
the author has a personal bias that affects the interpretation of results
questions.explain: 考点：论证削弱（weakening argument）。样本不具代表性直接削弱论证的有效性；其余选项虽也是潜在问题，但'数据来源单一且不具代表性'是最直接、最有力的削弱方式。

questions.stem: The word "conflated" (Line 3, Paragraph 2) most probably means ______.
opts: separated
confused
clarified
combined
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文猜测词义。conflate 本义为‘合并、混为一谈’，在学术文本中常指将不同概念错误地合并处理，此处 closest 为 combined。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 3, the decline in reading comprehension among college students is attributed to ______.
opts: the increasing use of social media platforms
the reduced emphasis on classic literature in curricula
the shift from deep reading to skimming behaviors
the lack of qualified teachers in higher education
questions.explain: 考点：细节定位。原文通常将阅读能力下降归因于从深度阅读向浏览式阅读的习惯转变，这是数字时代阅读研究的常见结论。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that the author believes ______.
opts: the current education system has fully adapted to digital changes
traditional teaching methods are completely outdated
a hybrid approach combining online and offline learning may be optimal
students should be banned from using digital devices in class
questions.explain: 考点：推理判断。进阶阅读中作者常主张线上线下混合模式为最优解，而非极端推崇或否定某一方。

questions.stem: The function of the first paragraph in relation to the rest of the passage is to ______.
opts: present a controversial thesis that the author later refutes
provide a historical background for the subsequent discussion
introduce a specific case study that illustrates the general argument
define key terms that will be used throughout the passage
questions.explain: 考点：篇章结构。首段常提供历史背景或上下文，为后续讨论奠定基础，而非直接提出被反驳的论点。

questions.stem: The phrase "a double-edged sword" (Line 5, Paragraph 4) is used to convey that ______.
opts: the tool is dangerous and should be avoided
the same factor can have both positive and negative effects
the issue has two completely unrelated aspects
the argument is contradictory and invalid
questions.explain: 考点：修辞理解。'双刃剑'比喻同一事物兼具利弊两面，进阶阅读中常考这种隐喻的准确理解。

questions.stem: What is the author's primary purpose in citing the study by Smith et al. (2022)?
opts: To refute a widely held misconception about the topic.
To provide empirical evidence supporting the author's claim.
To introduce a new perspective that contradicts the main argument.
To summarize the existing literature on the subject.
questions.explain: 考点：论据功能。引用研究的主要目的是为作者观点提供实证支持，而非反驳或引入矛盾视角，这是学术阅读的基本逻辑。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author's use of the phrase "a double-edged sword" primarily serves to indicate that the subject under discussion ______.
opts: has both positive and negative consequences
is sharp and dangerous
can be used for two different purposes
is a metaphor for conflict
questions.explain: 考点：理解比喻性短语在上下文中的修辞功能——"double-edged sword" 强调事物同时具有利弊两面，而非字面意义上的锋利或双重用途。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the author's attitude toward the proposed policy as revealed in the passage?
opts: Strongly supportive and optimistic
Cautiously skeptical with reservations
Indifferent and disinterested
Openly hostile and dismissive
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者态度——通过转折词、限定词（如 'however', 'yet', 'may'）和让步结构识别谨慎怀疑的态度，而非极端支持或反对。

questions.stem: The word "ameliorate" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ______.
opts: worsen
maintain
improve
ignore
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文猜测词义——'ameliorate' 意为“改善、减轻”，常与问题、状况等搭配，与 'improve' 同义。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the author believes the primary cause of the phenomenon is ______.
opts: government regulation
technological innovation
socioeconomic inequality
cultural tradition
questions.explain: 考点：推理隐含因果——通过文中因果链（如 'because', 'due to', 'as a result'）和对比结构推断作者认定的根本原因。

questions.stem: The example of the "butterfly effect" is cited in the passage to illustrate ______.
opts: the unpredictability of weather patterns
the interconnectedness of complex systems
the fragility of ecosystems
the importance of small changes in finance
questions.explain: 考点：识别例证与论点关系——"butterfly effect" 在阅读中常被用作比喻，说明微小变化在复杂系统中可能引发巨大连锁反应，强调相互关联性。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is true about the relationship between urbanization and public health?
opts: Urbanization invariably leads to worse health outcomes.
The effects of urbanization on health are uniformly positive.
Urbanization has both beneficial and detrimental effects on health.
There is no significant correlation between urbanization and health.
questions.explain: 考点：识别复杂关系的表述——进阶阅读中作者通常不持极端立场，而会指出事物的两面性，需要区分绝对化表述（invariably/uniformly）与平衡观点。

questions.stem: The author's argument in the last paragraph primarily relies on ______.
opts: statistical data and empirical evidence
appeals to authority and expert opinion
logical deduction and hypothetical reasoning
anecdotal examples and personal experience
questions.explain: 考点：识别论证方式——通过分析段落中的证据类型（数据、引用、逻辑推理、轶事）判断作者的主要论证手段。

questions.stem: What function does the final paragraph serve in relation to the rest of the passage?
opts: It introduces a completely new argument not mentioned before.
It reiterates the main points without adding new information.
It synthesizes previous arguments and offers a forward-looking conclusion.
It contradicts the central thesis presented earlier in the passage.
questions.explain: 考点：分析段落功能——末段通常起到综合前文、提出展望或深化主题的作用，而非简单重复或引入无关新论点。

questions.stem: The phrase "a double-edged sword" in the context of the passage most likely means that ______.
opts: the tool has two sharp edges for cutting
the same factor can produce both positive and negative effects
the research method is both innovative and outdated
the author holds a neutral attitude toward the subject
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文推断短语含义。"a double-edged sword"比喻同一事物既有积极影响也有消极影响，需结合语境理解比喻义。

questions.stem: Which of the following best summarizes the main idea of the third paragraph?
opts: The rapid urbanization has led to severe environmental degradation.
Technological innovation alone cannot solve complex social problems.
Historical evidence suggests a cyclical pattern of economic growth.
Individual efforts are more effective than government policies.
questions.explain: 考点：概括段落主旨。需区分段落核心论点与细节信息，正确选项应涵盖段落中心思想。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the proposed reform can best be described as ______.
opts: strongly supportive and optimistic
cautiously skeptical with reservations
completely indifferent and detached
fiercely opposed and critical
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者态度。需通过文中用词（如让步、限定词）判断作者立场，进阶难度要求识别隐含的保留态度。

questions.stem: According to the passage, one major reason for the decline in reading comprehension among adolescents is ______.
opts: the increasing popularity of visual media
the lack of qualified teachers in schools
the reduction of library funding nationwide
the overemphasis on standardized testing
questions.explain: 考点：定位文中明确原因。需区分文中直接给出的原因与干扰项中的无关或反向信息。

questions.stem: The word "paradigm" in line 15 is closest in meaning to ______.
opts: a typical example or pattern
a financial reward system
a controversial hypothesis
a statistical measurement
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文猜测词义。"paradigm"在学术语境中常指"范式、模式"，需排除其他领域的干扰义项。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the author would most likely agree with which of the following statements?
opts: Economic growth should always take priority over environmental protection.
Short-term sacrifices are necessary for long-term sustainable development.
Market forces alone can effectively regulate resource allocation.
International cooperation has little impact on climate change.
questions.explain: 考点：推理作者观点。需基于文中隐含逻辑推断作者可能同意的陈述，而非直接引用原文。

questions.stem: In the context of the passage, the term "cognitive load" refers to ______.
opts: the physical weight of textbooks
the mental effort required to process information
the emotional stress from peer competition
the time spent on repetitive tasks
questions.explain: 考点：理解学科术语在文中的具体含义。"cognitive load"是认知心理学概念，指信息处理所需的心智负担。

questions.stem: The author uses the example of "the Finnish education system" in paragraph 4 to ______.
opts: show that high investment guarantees better outcomes
demonstrate that alternative models can achieve success
prove that standardized tests are universally ineffective
suggest that smaller class sizes are the only solution
questions.explain: 考点：分析例证功能。作者举例通常是为了支持论点，正确选项需体现例子与论点之间的逻辑关系。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author's use of the phrase "a double-edged sword" primarily serves to indicate that the technology under discussion ________.
opts: has both beneficial and harmful effects
is too sharp to be handled safely
can cut in two opposite directions simultaneously
requires two operators to function properly
questions.explain: 考查修辞理解："double-edged sword" 是比喻，指事物兼具利弊两面，需结合上下文判断作者态度。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the author's attitude toward the proposed policy reform as presented in the text?
opts: Strong endorsement with minor reservations
Cautious optimism tempered by practical concerns
Outright rejection based on ideological grounds
Neutral reporting without personal stance
questions.explain: 考查观点态度题：通过文中 hedging 语言（如 'may', 'however', 'yet'）推断作者谨慎乐观的态度。

questions.stem: The word "ameliorate" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ________.
opts: exacerbate
mitigate
accelerate
complicate
questions.explain: 考查词义猜测：ameliorate 意为 '改善、减轻'，与 mitigate 同义，需结合上下文负面语境推断。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the primary reason why traditional economic models fail to predict market fluctuations is that they ________.
opts: overlook the role of irrational investor behavior
rely too heavily on historical data from the 20th century
assume perfect information symmetry among all participants
discount the impact of government intervention entirely
questions.explain: 考查细节定位：原文指出传统模型假设 'perfect information'，而现实信息不对称导致预测失效。

questions.stem: The author mentions the example of the 2008 financial crisis in paragraph 4 in order to ________.
opts: illustrate the catastrophic consequences of deregulation
contrast with the more stable economic period that followed
support the argument for stricter capital requirements
criticize the inaction of central banks during the crisis
questions.explain: 考查例证功能：例子用于支撑前文关于 'deregulation leads to disaster' 的论点。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements, if true, would most weaken the author's argument in the last paragraph?
opts: Recent studies show that renewable energy is now cheaper than fossil fuels.
Government subsidies for fossil fuels have been phased out in most countries.
Technological breakthroughs have made carbon capture economically viable.
Consumer demand for sustainable products has declined significantly.
questions.explain: 考查削弱推理：作者论证依赖 'growing consumer demand for sustainability'，若需求下降则核心前提被削弱。

questions.stem: The passage suggests that the main obstacle to implementing universal healthcare is not financial but ________.
opts: political opposition from pharmaceutical lobbies
administrative inefficiency in public sectors
cultural resistance to government intervention
lack of consensus on the definition of basic care
questions.explain: 考查隐含推断：原文通过 'not...but...' 结构强调文化层面的抵触才是真正障碍。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the author would most likely agree with which of the following statements about artificial intelligence?
opts: AI will inevitably surpass human intelligence within the next decade.
The ethical risks of AI are overstated by popular media.
Regulation of AI should prioritize transparency over speed of innovation.
Current AI systems lack the creativity fundamental to human cognition.
questions.explain: 考查推理判断：文中多处对比 AI 与人类思维，指出 AI 缺乏 'genuine creativity'，故作者最可能同意选项 D。

questions.stem: The structure of the passage can best be described as ________.
opts: problem-solution-evaluation
chronological narrative with flashbacks
comparison of two opposing theories
general principle followed by specific case studies
questions.explain: 考查篇章结构：首段提出问题，中间提出解决方案，末段评估方案优劣，符合 problem-solution-evaluation 结构。

questions.stem: The author's reference to "the law of unintended consequences" in the final paragraph is used to ________.
opts: warn against hasty implementation of untested policies
suggest that all policy changes lead to negative outcomes
dismiss the concerns of critics as theoretically unfounded
introduce a new argument that contradicts the previous point
questions.explain: 考查修辞目的：引用 'unintended consequences' 意在警示仓促推行未经充分测试的政策可能带来意外负面后果。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author's use of the phrase 'a double-edged sword' primarily serves to indicate that the subject under discussion ______.
opts: has both advantages and disadvantages
is extremely dangerous and should be avoided
can be used as a weapon in arguments
is a metaphor for conflict resolution
questions.explain: 考点：修辞理解。'双刃剑' 是典型比喻，暗示事物同时具有正面和负面效应，需结合上下文判断作者态度。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the author's attitude toward the proposed policy in the passage?
opts: Strongly supportive and enthusiastic
Cautiously optimistic with reservations
Completely indifferent and neutral
Openly critical and dismissive
questions.explain: 考点：态度推断。进阶阅读要求从措辞（如让步从句、限定词）中识别作者谨慎乐观的立场，而非极端支持或反对。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the primary reason for the decline in bee populations is ______.
opts: climate change alone
a combination of pesticides, habitat loss, and pathogens
natural evolutionary processes
overpopulation of other insect species
questions.explain: 考点：细节定位与综合。进阶题要求整合分散信息，识别多因一果的复杂关系，而非单一归因。

questions.stem: The author mentions the study by Smith et al. (2019) in order to ______.
opts: provide a counterexample to the main argument
introduce a new topic unrelated to the thesis
offer empirical support for the previous claim
criticize the methodology of earlier research
questions.explain: 考点：论据功能。识别引用研究的目的——通常为支撑前文论点，需区分 '反驳'、'引入新话题' 等干扰项。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from paragraph 2 that the traditional approach to urban planning ______.
opts: has been universally successful
failed to account for social equity
was based on outdated technology
is now widely adopted in developing countries
questions.explain: 考点：推理判断。进阶推理要求从隐含信息（如批评性措辞、对比）中推出传统方法的不足，而非直接陈述。

questions.stem: The structure of the passage can best be described as ______.
opts: problem-solution with a chronological narrative
compare-contrast between two opposing theories
general-to-specific with a concluding call to action
cause-effect followed by a rebuttal of counterarguments
questions.explain: 考点：篇章结构。识别宏观组织模式：从一般原理到具体应用，最后以呼吁结尾是典型议论文结构。

questions.stem: Which sentence best captures the main idea of the passage?
opts: Technological innovation alone can solve environmental crises.
Sustainable development requires balancing economic growth with ecological protection.
Government regulation is the only effective way to reduce carbon emissions.
Individual lifestyle changes are more important than corporate actions.
questions.explain: 考点：主旨概括。正确选项需涵盖全文核心论点（平衡发展），排除极端或片面选项。

questions.stem: The author's tone in discussing the critics' viewpoint can be characterized as ______.
opts: sarcastic and dismissive
respectful but ultimately rebutting
neutral and objective
enthusiastically endorsing
questions.explain: 考点：语气识别。进阶阅读要求识别 '先扬后抑' 策略——先承认对方合理性，再指出缺陷。

questions.stem: Based on the passage, which of the following would the author most likely agree with?
opts: Short-term economic gains should always take priority.
Long-term sustainability is worth temporary economic sacrifices.
Market forces will naturally correct environmental damage.
Scientific consensus is often unreliable and should be questioned.
questions.explain: 考点：观点推断。需根据全文立场推断作者对 '权衡取舍' 的态度，排除与主旨相悖的选项。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author mentions "the digital divide" primarily to illustrate that ______.
opts: technological progress has eliminated inequality
access to technology remains uneven across groups
the internet is a luxury rather than a necessity
governments have failed to regulate cyberspace
questions.explain: 考查细节理解与例证功能：作者提及“数字鸿沟”是为了说明不同群体在技术接入上仍存在不平等，而非技术进步已消除不平等。

questions.stem: The word "ameliorate" (Line 3, Paragraph 2) is closest in meaning to ______.
opts: worsen
improve
ignore
accelerate
questions.explain: 考查上下文猜词能力：根据语境，ameliorate 与 improve 同义，表示“改善、改进”之意。

questions.stem: Which of the following best reflects the author's attitude toward the proposed reform?
opts: Strongly supportive
Cautiously optimistic
Deeply skeptical
Completely neutral
questions.explain: 考查作者态度题：文中使用转折词 however 及质疑性措辞表明作者对改革持深度怀疑态度。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 3, one major consequence of the policy shift is that ______.
opts: small businesses have gained more market share
regulatory costs have been significantly reduced
consumer protection has been weakened
innovation has been stifled by bureaucracy
questions.explain: 考查段落细节定位：第三段明确指出政策转变导致消费者保护力度被削弱。

questions.stem: The author uses the example of "the 2008 financial crisis" in Paragraph 4 to ______.
opts: criticize the banking industry's greed
argue for stricter financial regulations
illustrate the failure of deregulation
compare two different economic models
questions.explain: 考查例证功能：作者引用2008年金融危机是为了说明放松监管的失败后果，而非单纯批评银行贪婪。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the current education system ______.
opts: fully prepares students for the job market
prioritizes standardized testing over creativity
has successfully closed the skills gap
receives adequate funding from the government
questions.explain: 考查推理判断：文中暗示现行教育体系过度强调标准化考试而忽视创造力培养，属于合理推断。

questions.stem: The phrase "a double-edged sword" (Line 5, Paragraph 5) is used to emphasize that ______.
opts: the tool has both advantages and disadvantages
the weapon is extremely dangerous
the policy has only negative effects
the situation is completely under control
questions.explain: 考查短语理解：a double-edged sword 比喻事物具有利弊两面性，强调既有优点也有缺点。

questions.stem: What does the last paragraph suggest about the future of the industry?
opts: It will inevitably decline due to outdated practices.
It is likely to undergo significant transformation.
It will remain unchanged despite external pressure.
It has already reached its peak of development.
questions.explain: 考查段落结论推断：末段指出行业面临变革压力，暗示未来很可能经历重大转型。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author mentions "the digital divide" primarily to illustrate that ________.
opts: technological advancement has eliminated inequality
access to information remains uneven across social groups
internet usage is now universal in developed countries
the gap between rich and poor has narrowed significantly
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者意图。作者提及“数字鸿沟”是为了说明不同社会群体之间信息获取的不平等仍然存在，而非技术进步已经消除不平等。

questions.stem: The word "mitigate" (Line 3, Paragraph 2) is closest in meaning to ________.
opts: intensify
alleviate
prolong
ignore
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文猜测词义。mitigate 意为“减轻、缓解”，与 alleviate 同义。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the proposed policy can best be described as ________.
opts: strongly supportive
cautiously optimistic
highly critical
indifferent
questions.explain: 考点：态度题。根据文中使用的负面评价词和反驳性论证，可推断作者对该政策持强烈批评态度。

questions.stem: According to the passage, one major drawback of the current approach is that it ________.
opts: relies too heavily on quantitative data
fails to address underlying structural issues
has been implemented without sufficient funding
ignores the role of individual initiative
questions.explain: 考点：细节题。文中明确指出当前方法未能解决根本性的结构问题，这是其主要缺陷。

questions.stem: The example of "the Finnish education system" is used in the passage to ________.
opts: show that high spending guarantees educational success
argue that standardized testing is universally effective
demonstrate that alternative models can achieve excellence
prove that smaller class sizes are always better
questions.explain: 考点：例证题。引用芬兰教育体系的例子是为了证明不同的模式同样可以达到卓越水平。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the author believes ________.
opts: technological innovation alone can solve environmental problems
economic growth should take precedence over ecological concerns
sustainable development requires balancing multiple competing interests
government regulation is the only effective way to protect the environment
questions.explain: 考点：推理判断题。从文中对多方利益的讨论可推断作者认为可持续发展需要平衡多种竞争性利益。

questions.stem: The phrase "a double-edged sword" (Line 5, Paragraph 3) suggests that the phenomenon ________.
opts: has both positive and negative effects
is too complex to be understood
affects only two groups of people
will eventually disappear on its own
questions.explain: 考点：短语理解题。“双刃剑”比喻事物同时具有正面和负面两种影响。

questions.stem: The passage is most likely taken from ________.
opts: a scientific research paper
a newspaper editorial
a product advertisement
a personal diary
questions.explain: 考点：文章出处题。文中带有观点性评论和论证结构，最可能出自报纸社论。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author mentions "cognitive dissonance" primarily to illustrate that people often ______.
opts: A. seek information that confirms their existing beliefs
B. avoid situations that challenge their self-esteem
C. rationalize contradictory behaviors to reduce mental discomfort
D. prefer simple explanations over complex reasoning
questions.explain: 考点：理解文中举例或术语的目的。认知失调（cognitive dissonance）指个体为减轻心理不适而合理化矛盾行为，C项准确概括了这一核心机制。

questions.stem: The phrase "begs the question" (Line 3, Paragraph 2) most likely means ______.
opts: A. raises an important inquiry
B. assumes the conclusion in the premise
C. prompts further investigation
D. avoids giving a direct answer
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文推断短语含义。"begs the question"是逻辑学术语，意为“循环论证”，即前提中已包含结论，B项正确。

questions.stem: Which of the following best captures the author's attitude toward the proposed reform?
opts: A. Enthusiastic endorsement
B. Cautious optimism
C. Skeptical reservation
D. Indifferent neutrality
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者态度。文中作者虽承认改革初衷良好，但多次指出其潜在弊端和可行性问题，态度为“怀疑性保留”，C项最贴切。

questions.stem: The comparison between the two experiments in Paragraph 3 serves to ______.
opts: A. highlight a methodological flaw in the earlier study
B. demonstrate the superiority of the later approach
C. illustrate the consistency of findings across contexts
D. question the validity of experimental psychology
questions.explain: 考点：理解段落内比较/对比的写作目的。作者通过对比指出早期实验在样本选择上的缺陷，A项正确。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the decline in newspaper readership is attributed mainly to ______.
opts: A. the rise of digital media platforms
B. a loss of trust in journalistic objectivity
C. the increasing cost of print subscriptions
D. a shift in readers' preference for visual content
questions.explain: 考点：定位细节并区分主次原因。文中明确指出“核心原因在于公众对新闻客观性信任度的下降”，B项为原文同义改写。

questions.stem: The word "ameliorate" (Line 5, Paragraph 4) is closest in meaning to ______.
opts: A. exacerbate
B. mitigate
C. accelerate
D. obscure
questions.explain: 考点：根据语境推测生词含义。"ameliorate"意为“改善、减轻”，与mitigate（缓解）同义，B项正确。

questions.stem: The author's argument in the last paragraph would be most weakened if it were true that ______.
opts: A. the correlation between income and happiness is bidirectional
B. most longitudinal studies use self-reported well-being measures
C. the sample in the cited study excluded low-income participants
D. economic growth has slowed significantly in recent decades
questions.explain: 考点：评估论证的潜在削弱因素。若研究样本排除了低收入群体，则结论“收入增加提升幸福感”的普适性存疑，C项构成最强削弱。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the author regards the traditional view of language acquisition as ______.
opts: A. largely outdated but still influential
B. fundamentally correct yet incomplete
C. empirically unsupported and misleading
D. theoretically elegant but practically irrelevant
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者对某种观点的评价。文中作者承认传统观点仍有影响力，但指出其已被新研究证明显著过时，A项准确。

questions.stem: The primary purpose of the passage is to ______.
opts: A. advocate for a new policy on urban green spaces
B. compare different approaches to environmental regulation
C. challenge a prevailing assumption about economic growth
D. explain the mechanisms behind a social phenomenon
questions.explain: 考点：概括文章主旨。全文围绕某一社会现象的成因展开机制性解释，而非倡导、比较或挑战特定观点，D项正确。

questions.stem: The author quotes the sociologist in Paragraph 5 in order to ______.
opts: A. provide authoritative support for the main argument
B. introduce a counterpoint that will later be refuted
C. illustrate a concept with a concrete example
D. acknowledge a limitation of the current study
questions.explain: 考点：识别引用的修辞功能。作者引用社会学家观点是为了引出对立论点，随后在下一段进行反驳，B项正确。

questions.stem: In the context of reading comprehension, what does the phrase 'the author's tone' primarily refer to?
opts: The speed at which the author writes
The emotional attitude conveyed by the author toward the subject
The volume of the author's voice when reading aloud
The number of characters used in the text
questions.explain: 考点：作者语气（tone）是作者对主题的情感态度，而非写作速度或音量。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the function of a 'topic sentence' in a paragraph?
opts: It provides a detailed example to support the main idea
It summarizes the entire passage in one sentence
It states the central idea of the paragraph
It introduces a contrasting viewpoint
questions.explain: 考点：主题句（topic sentence）是段落中心思想的直接陈述，而非细节或总结。

questions.stem: When an author uses the word 'however' to begin a sentence, what is the most likely purpose?
opts: To add more supporting evidence
To indicate a shift or contrast in thought
To introduce a new topic unrelated to the previous one
To emphasize a point already made
questions.explain: 考点：过渡词'however'标志逻辑转折，表示与前文观点相反或对比。

questions.stem: In reading comprehension, what is 'inference'?
opts: A statement explicitly made in the text
A conclusion drawn from evidence and reasoning within the text
A guess made without any textual support
A summary of the entire passage
questions.explain: 考点：推理（inference）是基于文本证据和逻辑得出的隐含结论，而非直接陈述。

questions.stem: The phrase 'the main idea' of a passage is best defined as:
opts: The most interesting detail in the text
The central point or argument the author wants to convey
A list of all facts mentioned in the passage
The author's personal opinion unrelated to evidence
questions.explain: 考点：主旨（main idea）是作者想要传达的核心观点或论点，而非细节罗列。

questions.stem: Which strategy is most effective for identifying an author's purpose in a persuasive text?
opts: Counting the number of adjectives used
Examining the rhetorical appeals (ethos, pathos, logos) and the call to action
Checking the publication date of the text
Memorizing all vocabulary words in the passage
questions.explain: 考点：识别作者目的需分析修辞手法（ethos/pathos/logos）和呼吁行动，而非表面特征。

questions.stem: What does it mean when a reading comprehension question asks about 'the organizational pattern' of a passage?
opts: The number of paragraphs in the passage
The way the author structures and arranges ideas (e.g., cause-effect, compare-contrast)
The font and layout used in the original publication
The alphabetical order of key terms
questions.explain: 考点：组织结构（organizational pattern）指作者安排观点的逻辑框架，如因果、对比等。

questions.stem: In academic reading, what is the role of 'transitional phrases' such as 'for example' or 'in addition'?
opts: To confuse the reader intentionally
To signal relationships between ideas and guide the reader through the argument
To replace the need for topic sentences
To indicate the end of the passage
questions.explain: 考点：过渡短语（transitional phrases）用于标示观点间的关系，引导读者理解论证逻辑。

questions.stem: When a passage uses the word 'ironically', what is the author most likely indicating?
opts: A straightforward statement of fact
A situation where the outcome is opposite to what was expected
A humorous joke unrelated to the main topic
A serious warning about future events
questions.explain: 考点：'ironically'（讽刺地）暗示结果与预期相反，是理解作者态度和修辞的关键信号词。

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of 'supporting detail' in a paragraph?
opts: The topic sentence that states the main idea
A specific fact, example, or statistic that backs up the main point
The concluding sentence that restates the main idea
A rhetorical question posed to the reader
questions.explain: 考点：支持细节（supporting detail）是用于佐证中心论点的具体事实、例子或数据。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the author's primary purpose in discussing the 'digital divide' is to ______.
opts: highlight the technological gap between developed and developing nations
criticize the unequal distribution of internet resources
advocate for government intervention in digital infrastructure
illustrate how economic factors influence access to information
questions.explain: 考查主旨意图题：作者讨论‘数字鸿沟’的核心目的是说明经济因素如何影响信息获取，而非单纯描述技术差距或批评资源分配。

questions.stem: Which of the following best summarizes the main argument of the second paragraph?
opts: Globalization has uniformly benefited all economies.
Cultural homogenization is an inevitable byproduct of globalization.
The economic integration of nations has both positive and negative consequences.
Local traditions are being completely replaced by global culture.
questions.explain: 考查段落主旨归纳：第二段通常呈现全球化利弊并存的辩证观点，而非绝对化表述。

questions.stem: The author mentions 'the Hawthorne effect' in the passage primarily to ______.
opts: introduce a new psychological theory
support the claim that observation alters behavior
refute a common misconception about workplace productivity
compare it with other experimental biases
questions.explain: 考查例证功能：引用‘霍桑效应’是为了证明‘被观察本身会改变行为’这一论点。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the researchers' initial hypothesis was ______.
opts: completely confirmed by the experimental data
partially supported but required further modification
rejected due to insufficient sample size
irrelevant to the actual findings
questions.explain: 考查推理判断：从实验描述可推断初始假设仅得到部分支持，需修正，而非完全证实或否定。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is NOT a factor contributing to language extinction?
opts: Economic globalization
Government language policies
Natural linguistic evolution
Increased tourism in remote areas
questions.explain: 考查细节排除：文中列举的语言消亡因素通常包括经济全球化、政府语言政策等，而‘偏远地区旅游业增长’并非直接原因，属于干扰项。

questions.stem: The author uses the analogy of 'a ship without a rudder' to illustrate ______.
opts: the lack of direction in current educational reforms
the instability of political institutions
the inefficiency of traditional teaching methods
the absence of moral guidance in modern society
questions.explain: 考查修辞理解：‘无舵之船’比喻当前教育改革缺乏明确方向，需结合上下文锁定比喻对象。

questions.stem: What is the author's attitude toward the proposed policy change?
opts: Strong approval
Cautious optimism
Outright opposition
Complete indifference
questions.explain: 考查作者态度：进阶阅读中作者态度常为‘谨慎乐观’，既看到政策积极面又指出潜在问题，而非极端支持或反对。

questions.stem: The passage suggests that the correlation between social media usage and depression may be ______.
opts: causal and direct
spurious and coincidental
complex and bidirectional
nonexistent in younger populations
questions.explain: 考查复杂因果关系推断：进阶阅读常强调相关关系并非简单因果，而是复杂双向的，需避免过度简化。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author mentions "cognitive dissonance" primarily to illustrate that people tend to ______.
opts: ignore evidence that contradicts their beliefs
seek out information that confirms their biases
change their attitudes to match their behaviors
avoid situations that cause mental discomfort
questions.explain: 考点：理解文中举例或术语的目的。关键推理：认知失调通常指人们因行为与信念冲突而产生不适，从而主动寻找支持自身立场的信息来缓解，故选项B（寻求确认偏差的信息）最贴合原文语境。

questions.stem: The word "ameliorate" in Paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ______.
opts: worsen
maintain
improve
disguise
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文猜测词义。关键推理：ameliorate 意为“改善、使更好”，文中语境常与缓解问题或提升状况相关，与 improve 同义。

questions.stem: Which of the following best summarizes the main argument of the passage?
opts: Technological innovation inevitably leads to social inequality.
The pace of digital transformation has outpaced regulatory frameworks.
Consumer privacy should be balanced against corporate profit motives.
Data-driven algorithms reinforce existing social biases.
questions.explain: 考点：把握全文主旨。关键推理：文章核心论点围绕算法如何放大社会偏见展开，选项D准确概括了这一批判性立场；其他选项虽可能提及但非主线。

questions.stem: The author's attitude toward the proposed policy can best be described as ______.
opts: strongly supportive
cautiously optimistic
deeply skeptical
neutrally objective
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者态度。关键推理：通过文中对政策缺陷的列举和负面评价用词（如 "flawed", "counterproductive"），可判断作者持深度怀疑立场。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is a consequence of the phenomenon described in Paragraph 2?
opts: Increased polarization among social groups
Enhanced efficiency in public service delivery
Greater transparency in government decision-making
Reduced participation in democratic processes
questions.explain: 考点：定位并理解段落中的因果逻辑。关键推理：第二段论述信息茧房导致群体观点极端化，选项A（社会群体间极化加剧）是直接后果。

questions.stem: The passage suggests that the traditional model of higher education is being challenged primarily by ______.
opts: declining government funding for public universities
the rise of online learning platforms and micro-credentials
changing demographic profiles of college applicants
increasing demand for vocational training programs
questions.explain: 考点：识别文中明确指出的挑战来源。关键推理：原文强调在线平台和微证书对传统学位体系的冲击最大，选项B与此直接对应。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the author would most likely agree with which of the following statements?
opts: Economic growth should take precedence over environmental protection.
International cooperation is essential for addressing climate change.
Market forces alone can solve the problem of carbon emissions.
Individual lifestyle changes matter more than systemic reforms.
questions.explain: 考点：根据全文立场进行合理推断。关键推理：文章反复强调跨国协作应对气候危机的必要性，选项B与作者核心观点一致。

questions.stem: The phrase "a double-edged sword" in the last paragraph is used to convey that the technology ______.
opts: has both benefits and drawbacks that are equally significant
is more harmful than beneficial in its current form
will eventually be replaced by a superior alternative
requires immediate regulation to prevent misuse
questions.explain: 考点：理解比喻修辞在文中的含义。关键推理：“双刃剑”比喻同一事物同时具有利弊两面，且程度相当，选项A准确解释了这一修辞。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the organization of the passage?
opts: A problem is identified, followed by an analysis of its causes and a proposed solution.
A historical overview is presented, then contrasted with current developments.
A controversial claim is made, supported by multiple examples and counterarguments.
Two competing theories are introduced, compared, and then synthesized.
questions.explain: 考点：把握篇章结构。关键推理：文章遵循“提出问题→分析原因→给出建议”的经典论述结构，选项A准确概括了这一逻辑脉络。

questions.stem: In the passage, the author uses the phrase 'a double-edged sword' to describe the impact of social media on political discourse. What does this metaphor primarily suggest?
opts: Social media is an ineffective tool for political communication.
Social media has both beneficial and harmful effects on political discussion.
Social media is primarily used for entertainment rather than politics.
Social media platforms are controlled by political elites.
questions.explain: 考点：理解隐喻修辞在语境中的含义。'双刃剑'比喻事物同时具有积极和消极两方面的影响，因此正确选项为B。

questions.stem: According to the passage, the author's attitude toward the proposed educational reform can best be described as:
opts: Strongly supportive
Cautiously optimistic
Deeply skeptical
Completely indifferent
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者态度/观点。通过文中使用的质疑性措辞和转折结构可判断作者持怀疑态度，故选C。

questions.stem: The word 'ubiquitous' in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to:
opts: Rare and exceptional
Everywhere and pervasive
Hidden and obscure
Temporary and fleeting
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文猜测词义。'ubiquitous'意为'无处不在的'，与B选项'普遍存在的'同义。

questions.stem: The author mentions the study conducted by Harvard researchers primarily to:
opts: Introduce a new research methodology.
Provide evidence supporting a previous claim.
Challenge the findings of an earlier experiment.
Highlight the limitations of current data.
questions.explain: 考点：识别论据与论点之间的关系。作者引用研究通常是为了支撑前文提出的观点，故选B。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the passage that the term 'cognitive load' refers to:
opts: The physical weight of learning materials.
The mental effort required to process information.
The emotional stress caused by exams.
The time needed to complete a task.
questions.explain: 考点：根据上下文推断术语含义。'认知负荷'指处理信息所需的脑力资源，与B选项一致。

questions.stem: The passage suggests that the decline in newspaper readership is primarily attributable to:
opts: The rising cost of print subscriptions.
The shift toward digital news consumption.
The decreasing quality of journalistic content.
The lack of interest in current events among younger generations.
questions.explain: 考点：识别因果关系。文中明确指出读者流失的主要原因是向数字新闻消费的转移，故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements about the author's use of rhetorical questions in paragraph 2 is true?
opts: They are used to express the author's uncertainty.
They serve to engage the reader and provoke critical thinking.
They indicate a shift from formal to informal tone.
They are answered directly in the following paragraph.
questions.explain: 考点：分析修辞手法的作用。反问句常用于引发读者思考而非表达疑问，B选项准确描述了这一功能。

questions.stem: The comparison between 'surface reading' and 'deep reading' in the passage is intended to illustrate:
opts: The superiority of one reading method over the other.
The different levels of comprehension in digital vs. print reading.
The historical evolution of reading practices.
The psychological benefits of recreational reading.
questions.explain: 考点：理解对比/比较的写作目的。作者通过对比两种阅读方式来说明数字阅读与纸质阅读在理解深度上的差异。

questions.stem: What is the primary purpose of the final paragraph in the passage?
opts: To summarize the main points and restate the thesis.
To introduce a counterargument for further discussion.
To provide additional data supporting the central claim.
To shift the focus to a completely new topic.
questions.explain: 考点：识别段落功能。结尾段通常用于总结全文观点并重申主旨，A选项符合这一功能。

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the author's attitude toward the proposed policy according to the passage?
opts: Wholehearted endorsement
Cautious optimism with reservations
Complete indifference
Vehement opposition
questions.explain: 考点：推断作者态度——通过转折词（however/but）和限定词（somewhat/partly）可识别有保留的积极态度。

questions.stem: The author mentions the example of the 'Silk Road' in paragraph 2 to ______.
opts: illustrate the historical origin of trade routes
contrast ancient and modern globalization
highlight the cultural exchange aspect
support the argument about economic interdependence
questions.explain: 考点：识别例证功能——例子通常用于支撑前文论点，需回看例子上文找观点句。

questions.stem: The passage is primarily concerned with ______.
opts: describing a historical event in detail
comparing two competing theories
analyzing the causes and effects of a phenomenon
arguing for a specific course of action
questions.explain: 考点：主旨大意题——需综合首段主题句及各段中心句，判断文章核心是分析因果关系。

questions.stem: Which of the following statements about the 'digital divide' is supported by the passage?
opts: It has been completely bridged in developed countries.
It is primarily a problem of hardware accessibility.
It persists despite increased internet penetration.
It affects only rural populations.
questions.explain: 考点：判断细节正误——需逐一比对选项与原文信息，注意绝对化表述（completely/only）常为错误选项。

questions.stem: The author's argument in the last paragraph assumes that ______.
opts: technological progress always benefits society
economic growth can be decoupled from resource consumption
individual actions are more important than systemic changes
short-term costs are irrelevant to long-term planning
questions.explain: 考点：识别隐含假设——论证中未明说但必须成立的前提，常出现在条件句或因果推理中。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'It is not easy to do justice to the complexity of the issue,' the phrase 'do justice to' is best translated as:
opts: 对……进行公正审判
充分展现/恰当处理
对……施加正义
对……做出补偿
questions.explain: 考查短语动词的英译汉。'do justice to' 意为'充分展现、恰当处理'，而非字面直译'进行公正审判'。

questions.stem: The translation of 'She was overcome with a sense of foreboding' should be:
opts: 她被一种预感征服了。
她心中涌起一种不祥的预感。
她被一种预兆打败了。
她克服了一种预感。
questions.explain: 考查被动结构与抽象名词的汉译。'was overcome with' 宜译为'心中涌起/充满'，'foreboding' 译为'不祥的预感'，避免生硬直译。

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best Chinese translation for 'The new policy cuts both ways'?
opts: 新政策一刀切。
新政策双管齐下。
新政策有利有弊。
新政策两头不讨好。
questions.explain: 考查习语'cuts both ways'的汉译，意为'有利有弊/有正反两面影响'，不可字面直译。

questions.stem: In translating 'He is a walking encyclopedia,' the most idiomatic Chinese equivalent is:
opts: 他是一个行走的百科全书。
他是一本活百科全书。
他是一个会走路的百科书。
他像百科全书一样走路。
questions.explain: 考查隐喻表达的归化翻译。'walking encyclopedia' 汉语习惯说'活百科全书'，而非字面直译'行走的百科全书'。

questions.stem: The sentence 'Not that I don't trust you, but I have to be cautious' is best rendered as:
opts: 不是我不信任你，而是我必须谨慎。
我不信任你，但我必须谨慎。
并不是说我不信任你，而是我必须谨慎。
我不信任你，所以必须谨慎。
questions.explain: 考查'Not that...but...'结构的汉译。应译为'并不是说……而是……'，保留原句的否定转移与对比逻辑。

questions.stem: Which translation best captures the meaning of 'The evidence is circumstantial at best'?
opts: 证据充其量是间接的。
证据在最好的情况下是情况性的。
证据是环境性的。
证据最多是细节性的。
questions.explain: 考查法律/学术语境中'circumstantial evidence'的译法，应译为'间接证据'；'at best'译为'充其量'。

questions.stem: The phrase 'a sense of entitlement' in modern English is best translated as:
opts: 一种权利感
一种理所应当的心态
一种资格感
一种拥有感
questions.explain: 考查文化负载词的意译。'a sense of entitlement' 指'认为理应得到某物的心态'，汉语常用'理所应当的心态/优越感'表达。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'The proposal was shot down in flames,' the idiom 'shot down in flames' means:
opts: 被击落并起火
被彻底否决
被猛烈批评
被火焰击落
questions.explain: 考查习语'be shot down in flames'的汉译，意为'被彻底否决/遭到惨败'，不可按字面直译。

questions.stem: The best Chinese translation for 'It's a moot point whether the plan will succeed' is:
opts: 计划能否成功是一个有争议的问题。
计划能否成功是一个无实际意义的问题。
计划能否成功是一个模拟的问题。
计划能否成功是一个沉默的问题。
questions.explain: 考查'moot point'在英式英语中的含义——'无实际意义/可争论但无结果的点'，而非'有争议的'。

questions.stem: Which translation correctly renders 'He gave a noncommittal answer'?
opts: 他给出了一个非承诺的答案。
他给出了一个不置可否的回答。
他给出了一个不承担义务的回答。
他给出了一个非委任的回答。
questions.explain: 考查'noncommittal'的汉译，意为'不表态的、不置可否的'，应选用汉语惯用表达，避免生硬直译。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'The importance of this discovery cannot be overemphasized.', the underlined part 'cannot be overemphasized' should be translated as:
opts: 不能被过度强调
无论怎样强调也不为过
不能被强调太多
无法被强调
questions.explain: 考查否定结构与比较级搭配的翻译技巧，'cannot...over-'结构应译为'无论怎样……也不为过'。

questions.stem: The phrase 'a matter of life and death' in the sentence 'For the trapped miners, every second was a matter of life and death.' is best translated as:
opts: 生死攸关的问题
生命与死亡的事情
一个关于生和死的问题
性命攸关的事
questions.explain: 考查固定习语的翻译，'a matter of life and death'译为'生死攸关的问题'更符合中文表达习惯。

questions.stem: In 'He is anything but a scholar.', the phrase 'anything but' should be translated as:
opts: 他是任何东西，但不是学者
他绝不是学者
他除了是学者什么都是
他几乎是个学者
questions.explain: 考查'anything but'的否定含义，应译为'绝不、根本不'，而非字面直译。

questions.stem: The sentence 'It is not that I dislike the plan, but that I think it is impractical.' should be translated as:
opts: 不是我不喜欢这个计划，而是我认为它不切实际
我不喜欢这个计划，我认为它不切实际
不是因为我不喜欢这个计划，而是我认为它不切实际
我不讨厌这个计划，但我觉得它不实用
questions.explain: 考查'not that...but that...'结构的翻译，应译为'不是……而是……'，保持对比关系。

questions.stem: In 'The more he tried to explain, the more confused I became.', the best Chinese translation is:
opts: 他越解释，我越困惑
他解释得越多，我变得越困惑
他越试图解释，我就越困惑
他解释得更多，我困惑得更多
questions.explain: 考查'the more...the more...'比较结构的翻译，需保留'越……越……'的递进关系，且动词'tried to explain'应完整译出。

questions.stem: The phrase 'as it were' in 'He is, as it were, a walking encyclopedia.' should be translated as:
opts: 就像它曾经是
可以说
正如它所是的
好像是
questions.explain: 考查插入语'as it were'的固定译法，应译为'可以说'或'好比'，表示比喻性说法。

questions.stem: In 'She was denied the opportunity to attend the conference.', the word 'denied' is best translated as:
opts: 被否认
被拒绝给予
被否定
被否认了
questions.explain: 考查'deny'在双宾语结构中的翻译，'deny sb. sth.'应译为'拒绝给予某人某物'，而非简单的'否认'。

questions.stem: The sentence 'What is known to all is that honesty is the best policy.' should be translated as:
opts: 众所周知的是，诚实是最好的策略
什么被所有人知道的是诚实是最好的策略
所有人都知道的是诚实为上策
众所周知，诚实为上策
questions.explain: 考查主语从句'What is known to all'的翻译，应译为'众所周知'这一成语，简洁自然。

questions.stem: In 'Not until the teacher came in did the students stop talking.', the best translation is:
opts: 直到老师进来，学生们才停止说话
不是直到老师进来，学生们停止了说话
老师进来之前，学生们没有停止说话
直到老师进来，学生们没有停止说话
questions.explain: 考查'Not until...'倒装结构的翻译，应译为'直到……才……'，体现时间状语从句的强调关系。

questions.stem: The phrase 'by no means' in 'This is by no means an easy task.' should be translated as:
opts: 绝不
通过没有方法
无论如何不
绝不意味着
questions.explain: 考查'by no means'的固定译法，应译为'绝不'，表示强烈否定，不可字面拆译。

questions.stem: In the sentence "The importance of this discovery cannot be overestimated", the most accurate Chinese translation is:
opts: 这一发现的重要性不能被高估。
这一发现的重要性怎么高估都不为过。
这一发现的重要性不能被低估。
这一发现的重要性无法被过高估计。
questions.explain: 考点：cannot...over-结构表‘再…也不为过’，否定转移导致肯定含义。

questions.stem: The phrase "a sea of faces" in English should be translated into Chinese as:
opts: 一片海洋般的面孔
人山人海
茫茫人海
众多面孔
questions.explain: 考点：英语隐喻‘a sea of’在汉语中应转化为‘茫茫人海’而非直译，符合汉语搭配习惯。

questions.stem: In the sentence "He is anything but a scholar", the correct Chinese translation is:
opts: 他什么都是，就是不是学者。
他绝不是一个学者。
他除了学者什么都是。
他可能是个学者。
questions.explain: 考点：anything but表‘绝不、根本不’，与nothing but（正是）形成对比。

questions.stem: The English sentence "It is a wise man that never makes mistakes" should be translated as:
opts: 聪明的人从不犯错。
再聪明的人也会犯错。
聪明的人不会犯错。
只有聪明人才不犯错。
questions.explain: 考点：It is + adj. + n. + that...结构表让步，意为‘再…也会…’，非字面肯定。

questions.stem: In the sentence "She was denied the opportunity to speak", the best Chinese translation is:
opts: 她被拒绝了说话的机会。
她被剥夺了发言的机会。
她否认了说话的机会。
她拒绝发言的机会。
questions.explain: 考点：deny sb. sth. 结构译为‘剥夺某人某物’，需注意被动语态与汉语搭配。

questions.stem: The English proverb "When in Rome, do as the Romans do" is idiomatically translated into Chinese as:
opts: 在罗马时，像罗马人那样做。
入乡随俗。
到了罗马就学罗马人。
随波逐流。
questions.explain: 考点：英语谚语应采用汉语对应习语‘入乡随俗’意译，而非字面直译。

questions.stem: In the sentence "He was found guilty of murder", the correct Chinese translation is:
opts: 他被发现犯有谋杀罪。
他被判犯有谋杀罪。
他被找到有谋杀罪。
他被认为犯有谋杀罪。
questions.explain: 考点：be found guilty 在司法语境中译为‘被判有罪’，而非字面‘被发现有罪’。

questions.stem: The English sentence "Not all that glitters is gold" should be translated as:
opts: 所有发光的东西都不是金子。
并非所有发光的东西都是金子。
发光的东西都不是金子。
不是所有发光的东西是金子。
questions.explain: 考点：not all 部分否定结构，应译为‘并非所有…都是’，而非全称否定。

questions.stem: In the sentence "The book sells well", the best Chinese translation is:
opts: 这本书被卖得很好。
这本书卖得很好。
这本书卖得好地被卖。
这本书好卖。
questions.explain: 考点：英语主动形式表被动含义（sell well），汉语用主动语态‘卖得好’即可。

questions.stem: The English sentence "He is too wise not to see that" should be translated as:
opts: 他太聪明了，以至于看不到那一点。
他太聪明了，不会看不到那一点。
他太聪明了，看不到那一点。
他太聪明了以至于看不到那一点。
questions.explain: 考点：too...not to...双重否定表肯定，意为‘太…以至于不会不…’。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'It is not that I dislike the work, but that I have no time.', the phrase 'not that... but that...' should be translated into Chinese as:
opts: 不是因为……而是因为……
不是那个……而是那个……
并不……但是……
不但不……反而……
questions.explain: 考查固定结构 'not that... but that...' 的英译汉，应译为“不是因为……而是因为……”，表示否定前者、肯定后者的因果关系。

questions.stem: The translation of 'He is anything but a scholar.' is:
opts: 他根本不是学者。
他什么都是，就是不是学者。
他除了学者什么都是。
他几乎是个学者。
questions.explain: 考查 'anything but' 短语的英译汉，意为“根本不、绝不”，故应译为“他根本不是学者”。

questions.stem: How should 'She is too wise not to know that.' be translated into Chinese?
opts: 她太聪明了，不知道那件事。
她太聪明了，不会不知道那件事。
她太聪明了，以至于不知道那件事。
她太聪明了，所以不知道那件事。
questions.explain: 考查 'too...not to...' 双重否定结构的英译汉，意为“太……以至于不会不……”，应译为肯定含义。

questions.stem: The English sentence 'He was the last person to say such a thing.' means in Chinese:
opts: 他是最后一个说这种话的人。
他绝不可能说这种话。
他上次说了这种话。
他刚刚说了这种话。

the findings
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句 'who had been working...' 的先行词是 'the professor'，'accompanied by his assistants' 是插入的伴随状语，不改变先行词。

questions.stem: The researchers argue that the phenomenon, while not entirely unprecedented, is nevertheless significant enough to warrant further investigation, and that previous studies have largely overlooked its implications. The number of 'that'-clauses serving as objects of 'argue' is ______.
opts: one
two
three
four
questions.explain: 'argue' 后接两个并列的 'that' 宾语从句：第一个 'that the phenomenon...investigation'，第二个 'that previous studies...implications'。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'It was the lack of transparency in the decision-making process that ultimately led to the public's distrust of the committee,' the structure 'It was...that...' is used to emphasize ______.
opts: the public's distrust
the decision-making process
the lack of transparency
the committee
questions.explain: 该句为强调句型 'It is/was + 被强调部分 + that + 剩余部分'，被强调的成分是 'the lack of transparency'。

questions.stem: The theory, which has been widely accepted for decades, is now being challenged by new evidence that suggests a different interpretation of the data, much to the surprise of the academic community. The phrase 'much to the surprise of the academic community' functions as ______.
opts: an adverbial clause
an adverbial phrase
a noun phrase
a prepositional phrase
questions.explain: 'much to the surprise of...' 是固定副词性短语（adverbial phrase），在句中作结果状语，修饰整个主句。

questions.stem: Not until the final stage of the experiment did the researchers realize that the control group had been contaminated, which rendered the entire data set invalid. The sentence uses inversion because ______.
opts: the sentence begins with a negative adverbial
the subject is too long
it is a conditional sentence
the verb is in past tense
questions.explain: 'Not until...' 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装（助动词 'did' 提前），这是否定状语前置引起的倒装结构。

questions.stem: The proposal that the university should allocate more funds to the humanities department, which has been underfunded for years, was met with both support and opposition. The grammatical function of the clause 'that the university should allocate more funds to the humanities department' is ______.
opts: an attributive clause modifying 'proposal'
an appositive clause explaining 'proposal'
an adverbial clause of purpose
a subject clause
questions.explain: 'that' 引导的从句对 'proposal' 的内容进行具体说明，是同位语从句，而非定语从句（that 在从句中不充当成分）。

questions.stem: The more carefully the data are examined, the more likely it becomes that the initial hypothesis, however plausible it may seem, will be found inadequate. The main clause of this sentence is ______.
opts: the more carefully the data are examined
the more likely it becomes
that the initial hypothesis will be found inadequate
however plausible it may seem
questions.explain: 'The more..., the more...' 结构中，前半部分是从句（条件状语），后半部分是主句，主句核心是 'the more likely it becomes'，后接 'that' 主语从句。

questions.stem: Had the committee taken the minority report into consideration, the final decision, which was widely criticized as biased, might have been more balanced and fair. The underlined part 'Had the committee taken...' is equivalent to ______.
opts: If the committee had taken
If the committee would have taken
If the committee took
If the committee has taken
questions.explain: 'Had + 主语 + 过去分词' 是虚拟条件句的倒装形式，相当于 'If the committee had taken...'，表示与过去事实相反的假设。

questions.stem: The extent to which the process of aging can be slowed down, if not completely halted, remains a subject of intense scientific debate. Which of the following best describes the grammatical function of the clause "to which the process of aging can be slowed down"?
opts: It is an adverbial clause modifying "remains".
It is a relative clause modifying "extent".
It is a noun clause serving as the subject.
It is a result clause indicating outcome.
questions.explain: 考点：定语从句（介词+which结构）。"to which"引导定语从句修饰先行词"extent"，相当于"the extent that..."，在从句中作介词"to"的宾语。

questions.stem: That the brain can reorganize itself in response to injury, a phenomenon known as neuroplasticity, has been confirmed by numerous studies. What is the grammatical role of the phrase "a phenomenon known as neuroplasticity"?
opts: It is a subject complement modifying "brain".
It is an appositive modifying the entire that-clause.
It is a participial phrase acting as an adverbial.
It is an object complement of "confirmed".
questions.explain: 考点：同位语结构。"a phenomenon known as neuroplasticity"是前面整个that从句的同位语，对从句内容进行补充说明。

questions.stem: Not until the 19th century did scientists begin to understand the complex interplay between genetics and environment in determining an organism's traits. The inverted structure "did scientists begin" is used because:
opts: The sentence begins with a negative adverbial expression.
The subject "scientists" is too long to stay in normal position.
The main verb "begin" requires inversion after "until".
The sentence expresses a conditional meaning.
questions.explain: 考点：否定词前置引起的部分倒装。"Not until..."位于句首时，主句需要部分倒装，将助动词"did"提到主语之前。

questions.stem: The hypothesis, that the universe is expanding at an accelerating rate, was first proposed based on observations of distant supernovae. The commas around "that the universe is expanding at an accelerating rate" indicate that this clause is:
opts: A restrictive relative clause essential to the noun.
A non-restrictive appositive clause providing additional information.
A parenthetical adverbial clause of reason.
A conditional clause modifying the main verb.
questions.explain: 考点：同位语从句的限定性与非限定性。逗号分隔的同位语从句为非限定性（非限制性），提供补充说明而非必要信息。

questions.stem: What distinguishes this approach from previous ones is its emphasis on real-time data processing, which allows for immediate adjustments. The subject of the main clause is:
opts: "What distinguishes this approach from previous ones"
"its emphasis"
"real-time data processing"
"which allows for immediate adjustments"
questions.explain: 考点：名词性从句作主语。"What distinguishes this approach from previous ones"是what引导的名词性从句，在整个句子中充当主语。
